Help Build the Future of Enterprise AI Infrastructure

Enterprise AI is changing how organizations think about technology infrastructure, and Cerio is helping shape what comes next. We’re building an open systems platform designed to make AI and accelerated computing more efficient, scalable, and sustainable.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll have the opportunity to help define a growing market, build strategic relationships with senior technology leaders, and create opportunities with enterprise customers. This role is ideal for a commercially driven, entrepreneurial sales leader who thrives on opening doors, solving complex customer challenges, and helping build something significant.

What You'll Do

  • Build strategic enterprise relationships with C-suite, business, and technical decision-makers, positioning Cerio as a trusted partner in AI infrastructure transformation
  • Create and grow pipeline through targeted account development, executive engagement, industry networks, and strategic partners
  • Lead complex enterprise sales cycles from initial engagement through close, navigating buying committees, building consensus, negotiating, and driving deals forward
  • Connect technology to business value by translating complex infrastructure solutions into clear outcomes around growth, innovation, efficiency, sustainability, and competitive advantage
  • Shape Cerio’s go-to-market strategy by bringing customer and market insights into messaging, positioning, sales plays, and growth opportunities
  • Collaborate across the organization with leadership, technical teams, delivery teams, and partners to win opportunities and deliver strong customer outcomes
  • Drive predictable growth through disciplined pipeline management, accurate forecasting, and accountability for revenue results

What you bring

  • 7+ years of enterprise technology sales experience
  • A demonstrated track record of exceeding revenue targets
  • Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles
  • Experience selling strategic technology solutions to executive buyers
  • Success building pipeline through proactive business development
  • Experience navigating multi-stakeholder enterprise buying environments
  • Strong business acumen and executive communication skills
  • Experience developing account strategies that drive long-term growth

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly valued

  • AI and machine learning platforms
  • Cloud infrastructure
  • Data center technologies
  • Networking and infrastructure solutions
  • High-performance computing (HPC)
  • GPU and accelerated computing environments
  • Enterprise software platforms
  • Hybrid cloud and modern infrastructure solutions

Why Join Cerio

This is a pivotal time in the evolution of enterprise AI infrastructure at Cerio. You’ll have the opportunity to help shape an emerging market, work closely with leadership, and make a meaningful impact as we grow. For an ambitious, high-performing sales professional, this is a chance to build your career while helping customers navigate one of the most important technology shifts of our time.

Total Rewards

Compensation for this role is determined by experience, skills, and internal equity considerations. Cerio offers a comprehensive total rewards package including competitive base salary, performance-based sales incentive plan, health and wellness benefits, generous paid time off, flexible work arrangements, and opportunities for professional growth.

About Cerio

Cerio is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, with offices and projects spanning international markets and Centers of Excellence across Europe and North America. Cerio is creating new scale economics for the AI and cloud era through an open systems platform designed to enable a more sustainable and efficient data center. Our innovation has no boundaries. We have built a culture that embraces flexibility, collaboration, and high performance, supporting both remote and hybrid work environments. Learn more about us at

Cerio is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. In addition, Cerio is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities. Job Description - Content Marketing Strategist

Reports To: Marketing Manager

Department: Marketing

Location: Remote

Position Type: Full-Time

Position Summary

AxisCare is seeking a strategic and creative Content Marketing Strategist to develop and execute content strategies that support integrated campaigns, organic growth, thought leadership, and broader marketing goals. This role will play a key part in developing integrated campaigns, with a strong understanding of how to create authoritative, discoverable content for traditional search and AI-powered answer engines. The ideal candidate is a strong writer and strategist who can turn business priorities and audience needs into content that drives results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute content strategies and editorial plans based on audience needs, search behavior, industry trends, and marketing priorities to support integrated campaigns, organic growth, customer journeys, brand initiatives, and business goals
  • Partner with the Marketing Manager and cross-functional teams to develop campaign themes, messaging, content plans, and supporting assets
  • Collaborate with creative, SEO, Product Marketing, and other teams to bring content strategies and campaigns to life, applying SEO and GEO best practices to improve content discoverability and visibility
  • Continuously evaluate content performance, search intent, content gaps, and business priorities to identify new content opportunities and optimize existing content for greater impact
  • Develop strategic campaign briefs that guide audience targeting, messaging, structure, sourcing, and search optimization
  • Own content projects from concept through execution, coordinating stakeholders, timelines, and deliverables
  • Write and edit high-impact content, including blogs, white papers, research reports, web copy, email campaigns, press releases, and thought leadership
  • Develop repurposing and distribution strategies to extend cornerstone content across web, email, social, and campaigns
  • Analyze content performance and search visibility to identify insights and inform future strategy
  • Stay current on SEO, AEO, GEO, content marketing, and AI search trends and recommend relevant opportunities
  • Use AI and automation where appropriate to streamline research, analysis, organization, and repetitive workflows while maintaining human judgment and ownership of content strategy, accuracy, originality, and brand voice
  • Support broader brand initiatives, including executive thought leadership, awards, product reviews, and other content projects as needed
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned by the Marketing Manager
  • Develop repeatable content frameworks, workflows, and standards that improve quality, consistency, and scalability across content creation and distribution

What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Strategic thinker with experience turning business objectives and audience insights into content strategies and campaigns
  • Experience developing content strategies, editorial plans, and integrated campaigns from ideation through execution
  • Strong understanding of SEO and emerging AEO/GEO practices, including how content can be structured for visibility across traditional and AI-powered search
  • Ability to conduct topic, keyword, search intent, and content gap research and translate findings into content opportunities
  • Strong understanding of content architecture, internal linking, authoritative sourcing, and topical authority
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and editorial judgment across long-form, web, email, campaign, and thought leadership content
  • Maintain high standards for content quality, accuracy, originality, brand voice, and source credibility across owned content.
  • Team oriented with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate across functions
  • Self-starter who can independently own projects, make strategic recommendations, and adapt as priorities shift
  • Creative and strategic thinker
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
  • Comfort using AI and emerging technologies to improve workflow efficiency, with sound judgment around responsible use
  • Ability to analyze content and campaign performance and apply insights to future strategy
  • Proficiency in marketing automation and content management tools (WordPress, HubSpot, Canva, etc.)

What We'd Be Excited To Find (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, or equivalent experience
  • 4+ years of content marketing, brand marketing, or communications experience, preferably in B2B SaaS, healthcare, or healthtech
  • Experience contributing to or owning integrated marketing campaigns, editorial calendars, or content programs
  • Experience developing content for organic search, with knowledge of SEO and emerging AEO/GEO practices
  • Experience collaborating with subject matter experts, executives, Product Marketing, SEO, demand generation, and creative teams to develop content

Working Conditions

  • Manual dexterity required to use desktop computer and peripherals.
  • Utilization of software and email to perform job functions

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
  • Medical insurance premiums are covered in full for the employee (Medical, Dental and Vision) 
  • 401K with competitive company matching.
  • Personal time off, sick leave, and holidays.
  • Company will provide laptop and other needed computer equipment.

About AxisCare

According to Pew Research, roughly 10,000 baby boomers turn 65 every day, and the American Society on Aging calculated that an American has a 70% chance of needing help with activities of daily living such as dressing, bathing, hygiene, etc. This has led to an unprecedented increase in Home Care agencies in the U.S. and abroad who strive to help those who have difficulty helping themselves, specifically offering non-medical (also referred to as non-skilled) services to seniors in their homes.

AxisCare was started in 2011 by industry leaders to help meet the demand for a more userfriendly and mobile-compatible solution. Our product is a web-based management platform that helps agencies manage CRM and marketing, Caregiver/Client scheduling, billing, payroll and much more. Headquartered in Waco, TX, AxisCare has clients in all 50 states as well as 7 other countries. We are a fast-growing company seeking high-performing individuals looking for a fast-paced, autonomous working environment.

raw.excerpt: The CompanyTorn Banner Studios is a Toronto, Canada-based independent game development studio founded in 2010.
raw.description:
The Company

Torn Banner Studios is a Toronto, Canada-based independent game development studio founded in 2010. We first made our mark with Chivalry: Medieval Warfare, a multi-million copy selling title that redefined melee combat in gaming. Since then, we’ve continued to grow and innovate, releasing Chivalry 2 and, most recently, No More Room in Hell 2. Today, our team of around 100 developers is dedicated to creating fun, cinematic and social gaming experiences.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Technical Level Designer to join our team and help bridge the gap between Level Design and Engineering on a multiplayer game project.

In this role, you will own the technical implementation and architecture in Unreal 5 of gameplay-focused level actors and Blueprints, ensuring they are robust, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with multiplayer best practices. You will work closely with Level Designers and the Code team to translate design requirements into effective technical solutions and will help establish best practices and technical standards for a new project.

This is a senior level role

with strong technical ownership. You should be comfortable navigating the world of code, understanding technical concepts, familiar with scripting in languages like Python, Javascript or C#, and making informed technical decisions within your area of expertise.

Note: While this role can be carried out remotely, candidates are required to be current Ontario or Quebec residents or willing to relocate to Ontario.

Responsibilities

  • Own the Blueprints and technical actors used by Level Design, ensuring they are well-structured, maintainable, performant, and easy for designers to use.
  • Design and implement gameplay and level systems using Unreal Engine Blueprints, with a strong focus on multiplayer and network replication.
  • Take ownership of systems such as destruction actors, interactive environmental objects and other reusable level gameplay actors.
  • Establish and promote Blueprint best practices, particularly around multiplayer, replication, performance, reusability, and maintainability.
  • Review and improve existing Blueprints and actors, ensuring they remain in good technical shape as the project evolves.
  • Act as a technical bridge between Level Design and Engineering, translating design requirements into clear and effective technical solutions, tools and documentation.
  • Communicate technical constraints and requirements to Level Designers and help the team make informed implementation decisions.
  • Help define technical standards and workflows that allow Level Designers to work efficiently while maintaining a high level of technical quality.
  • Identify technical risks and blockers within Level Design and work proactively with Engineering to resolve them.
  • Contribute to the technical vision and evolution of Level Design workflows on the project.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 Years experience working with Unreal Engine in a game development environment.
  • Strong understanding of Blueprint architecture and best practices.
  • Experience working on multiplayer games, with a solid understanding of replication and networked gameplay concepts.
  • Ability to understand technical requirements and translate them into practical Blueprint solutions.
  • Comfortable working closely with programmers and level designers navigating technical discussions.
  • Ability to read and understand script code.
  • Experience creating reusable, scalable, and maintainable gameplay or level actors.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make technical decisions within your area of ownership.
  • A proactive mindset and the confidence to establish and advocate for technical best practices.

Bonus Points

  • Basic familiarity with C++ or programming concepts.
  • Experience with Python or other scripting languages.

Benefits & Perks

  • 6.5 weeks paid vacation
  • Eligible for Employee Stock Options Plan
  • Flexible schedule and work location, with your choice of remote, hybrid, or on-site.
  • Healthcare & benefits plan, for you and your family
  • 100% parental leave top-up for 16 weeks, for Canadian employees.

To see our team, our office and what we do as a company visit We are Torn Banner Studios .

Torn Banner Studios welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Compensation

  • The pay range for this role is $100,000 - $150,000 per year. The range for this role represents candidates across a wide range of skills and experience for the position. Increased salaries may be achievable for those who have achieved mastery and deep industry knowledge over time. Your specific offer will rely on your unique experience and alignment to our team's needs for the position.

Transparency on use of AI and position vacancy

  • Our recruitment process does not use artificial intelligence to automatically screen, assess, or select applicants. All decisions on progressing, rejecting, and offering candidates are made by human reviewers.
  • One AI–enabled tool that may be used during the interview process is that of interview recording, transcription, and summarizing. Again, this would not make decisions, but simply make reviewing the notes easier. We will always ask for the candidates approval before using such a tool.
  • In compliance with Ontario regulations, the advertised posting is for a currently vacant position.

Job Title: Customer Success Specialist

Location: Phoenix, Arizona. USA

Reports to: Director Operations, USA

About 1Valet

1Valet is a Canadian technology company transforming the way people interact with
their buildings. We develop smart building software and integrated hardware solutions
that connect property managers, residents, and visitors—creating seamless, secure,

and intelligent building experiences.

We’re a growing company where every team member plays a pivotal role. Our products
are installed in properties across North America, and we’re rapidly expanding. Join us
as we shape the future of smart buildings.

Position Overview:

The Customer Success Specialist (Onboarding) is responsible for ensuring new
customers successfully adopt the platform from the moment they sign up. This role
focuses on guiding customers through the onboarding journey, helping them understand
key features, configuring the platform to meet their needs, and ensuring they achieve

early value quickly.

The specialist acts as the primary point of contact for new customers during their
onboarding phase, providing training, answering questions, and proactively identifying
potential challenges. By building strong relationships and ensuring a smooth onboarding
experience, this role helps drive customer satisfaction, product adoption, and long-term

retention.

Customer Success Specialists collaborate closely with Sales, Product, and Support
teams to ensure customer expectations are aligned and that feedback from onboarding
is shared to continuously improve the customer experience.

Responsibilities:

Guide new customers through the onboarding process from kickoff to successful

platform adoption.

Conduct onboarding calls, product walkthroughs, and training sessions

Help customers become proficient in configuring the platform based on their

goals and use cases.

Act as the primary contact for onboarding-related questions and support.

Track onboarding progress and customer engagement in CRM or customer

success tools.

Identify potential risks to successful adoption and proactively address them

Collect customer feedback and share insights with Product and Customer

Success leadership.

Collaborate with Sales for smooth handoffs and accurate expectation setting

Create or maintain onboarding documentation, guides, and training resources

Manage a book of pre-existing 1VALET clients, facilitating any upselling,

renewals, and cross-selling.

Build sustainable relationships and trust with customer accounts through open

and interactive communication.

Align customer experience strategies with marketing initiatives, ensure
customers are always informed about new product features and functionalities.

Core Skills:

Strong communication and presentation skills

Ability to simplify complex software for non-technical users

Customer-focused problem solving

Organization and project management for managing multiple onboarding

timelines

Familiarity with SaaS platforms, CRM tools, and customer success workflows

Qualifications:

Degree or diploma in Business Administration, marketing, sales, computer
science, or any other relevant area of study.
3+ years of experience in a Customer Success or Account Management role
Experience as a property manager or in a software company operating on a
related field (property technology, access control or security)
Familiarity with Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and CX/CRM software

What we offer:

A culture of ownership and autonomy - you will thrive if you are a self-starter and

enjoy a fast-paced environment

Work with an incredible product - there is true belief across our team that we

have the best product on the market

Trust and flexibility - work from home and flexible schedules. We care about your
performance, not your hours. We trust you to manage your time in a way that
works best for you.
Competitive compensation structure and 100% employer-paid benefits
Extra perks: employee stock option packages, employer-paid benefits, 10-day
holiday office shutdown each December, and support for professional growth.

Working With Us:

As a proud equal-opportunity employer, we consider all applicants for employment and
openly encourage those who identify as members of underrepresented communities to
apply to join our growing team. Join us, leave your mark, and let's make something

extraordinary,

Salary: $60,000

raw.description:
Summary

SafetyChain Software is looking for a Senior Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our Sales team. This is a senior position within our BDR team.

We're building a team that operates at the cutting edge, our BDRs are expected to actively use AI tools to research accounts, build better outreach, and find creative ways to generate pipeline faster. If you've figured out how to use AI to work smarter and do more, you'll fit right in here.

About Us:

SafetyChain is a rapidly scaling B2B SaaS provider revolutionizing plant management for Food and Beverage manufacturers by improving yield, maximizing productivity, and ensuring compliance. Our impressive client base includes renowned brands like Albertsons, Clif Bar, Tyson Foods, and Whole Foods. Join a dynamic, collaborative team driven by innovation, agility, and rapid growth.

We are a remote-first company. While this role is primarily remote, there may be occasional opportunities to collaborate in person for quarterly business reviews, team training, or customer visits. This is completely optional and flexible based on your location and preferences.

Key Responsibilities:

The Senior Business Development Representative (BDR) will play a critical role in moving prospective buyers through the sales funnel. You will engage with inbound leads—primarily Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs)—as well as manage outbound pipeline, previous customers who move to prospect accounts, recycled leads and re-engagement opportunities. Your focus will be to qualify prospects, nurture early interest, and set high-quality appointments for our Account Executives.

  • Lead Engagement
  • Lead Management
  • Qualification
  • Sourcing previous customers who move to prospect accounts
  • Relationship Building
  • Top-of-Funnel Excellence
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Problem Solving
  • Continuous Learning

Performance Expectations

  • Activity Targets: Approximately 50-60 outreach activities (calls, emails, LinkedIn touches) per day.
  • SQL Goal: 14 qualified sales opportunities per month.
  • Speed-to-Lead: Initial outreach to inbound leads within 5 minutes..
  • We’ll provide the tools, training, and support to help you hit these numbers confidently.

Qualifications:

  • Have a demonstrated track record of hitting or exceeding quota as a BDR/SDR or equivalent sales development experience, preferably within the B2B/SaaS or enterprise software industry.
  • Willing to experiment with new tools and approaches to find what generates pipeline.
  • Comfortable experimenting with AI tools to improve outreach quality and efficiency
  • Have strong organizational and time management skills—you can keep moving even when managing a high volume of leads.
  • Are a self-starter who’s motivated to succeed in sales and open to feedback along the way.
  • Communicate clearly, listen actively, and can build rapport with all kinds of people.
  • Are comfortable learning and using tools like Sales Navigator, HubSpot, and Outreach.
  • Are a natural problem solver who stays proactive and focuses on results.
  • Are eager to learn, grow, multi-task, and take on new challenges. We invest in our people.

Growth Path: This role is designed as a stepping stone. High performers can expect a path into an Account Executive role within 18-24 months.

Why Join Us?

At SafetyChain Software, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and professional growth:

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Retirement Planning: A 401(k) plan with company matching to help you save for the future.
  • Work-Life Balance: Unlimited paid time off (PTO) and holidays to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Professional Development: Opportunities for continuous learning, including access to training resources, workshops, and conferences.
  • Flexible Work Environment: Fully Remote with a generous monthly home office payment.
  • Employee Engagement: Regular team-building activities, company events, and an inclusive work culture that values diversity and collaboration.

Personal Attributes We Value

  • Experimentalism: you're willing to test new tools, sequences, and tactics without needing perfect conditions to get started. You learn by doing, debrief honestly, and apply it fast.
  • Initiative: you are a scrappy, self-motivated go-getter with the ability to accept and incorporate coaching and feedback.
  • Collaborative: you seek opportunities to learn from others, solicit honest feedback and always have the best interests of the team and our customers in mind.
  • Inquisitiveness: a desire to expand your knowledge base and explore concepts and ideas that are new and unfamiliar.
  • Process Driven: you are highly structured, disciplined and organized in creating and executing operational processes to ensure a consistent, repeatable outcome.
  • Integrity: you do what you say you will do and don’t let your colleagues or customers down.
  • Patience: the ability to adapt to changing situations while remaining calm, collected, and committed.
  • Self-improvement: the ability to identify mistakes and quickly adjust approach when confronted with new information or perspective.

Equal Opportunity Employer: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law applicable to the state in which you work.

Salary: 70k base, d.o.e. + Commission

Are you passionate about transforming complex risk, compliance, and investigation workflows into intuitive customer experiences?


Do you enjoy partnering with customers and cross-functional teams to shape innovative, AI-assisted products that solve real-world challenges?


About the Business

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Business Services vertical, we offer a multitude of solutions focused on helping businesses of all sizes drive higher revenue growth, maximize operational efficiencies, and improve customer experience. Our solutions help our customers solve difficult problems in the areas of Anti-Money Laundering/Counter Terrorist Financing, Identity Authentication & Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk mitigation and Customer Data Management. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at


About our Team

The Bankers Almanac Product Team is responsible for defining and delivering the next generation of Counterparty Due Diligence solutions. As we evolve our platform through AI, automation, and advanced data intelligence, we are focused on transforming how financial institutions discover, evaluate, and manage counterparty risk. Our team combines deep customer understanding, innovative product thinking, and cutting-edge technology to deliver impactful solutions that improve compliance, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes.


Our team works in a fast-paced environment focused on rapid experimentation, iterative delivery, and customer-centered innovation. We partner closely with technology, design, data science, sales, marketing, strategy, and executive leadership to bring transformative solutions to market.


About the Role

The Senior UX Designer will lead all UX design activities for KYC Orchestrator and serve as the key voice of the user representing UX within this product team. You will work closely with Product Management, UX Research, Engineering, Data Science, Architecture, and business stakeholders to understand customer needs and design effective product experiences.


You will help shape the product from its early stages by understanding customer workflows, exploring important use cases, creating and testing design concepts, and translating findings into clear design recommendations.


The successful candidate will be comfortable working on complex and evolving product challenges. You will combine customer-centered thinking with hands-on design execution, use research and product evidence to guide your work, and help cross-functional partners better understand the needs of users.


Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end UX design for KYC Orchestrator, from customer discovery and concept development through implementation.
  • Translate complex KYC data, risk signals, evidence, and investigation workflows into intuitive, actionable user experiences.
  • Create customer journeys, information architecture, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, design patterns, and high-fidelity designs.
  • Design and explore AI-assisted experiences with appropriate transparency, evidence visibility, human review, and user control.
  • Partner with Product Management and customers to conduct interviews, workflow analysis, concept testing, and usability evaluations.
  • Use customer feedback, research, analytics, and product data to validate problems and continuously improve solutions.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Research, and other stakeholders to balance customer needs, business goals, and technical requirements.
  • Lead design reviews and communicate design concepts, research findings, recommendations, and tradeoffs to technical and business stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Experience in UX, product, interaction, or related design roles.
  • Experience designing complex digital products, SaaS platforms, enterprise applications, or workflow-driven systems.
  • Demonstrated experience leading UX design for products, features, or significant initiatives.
  • Strong skills in interaction design, information architecture, prototyping, user flows, wireframing, and high-fidelity design.
  • Proficiency with Figma and familiarity with modern design tools and practices.
  • Experience translating customer research, feedback, analytics, and product insights into effective design solutions.
  • Strong communication, presentation, facilitation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Portfolio demonstrating customer-centered problem solving, design execution, iteration, and collaboration.

Preferred Qualification

  • Experience with data-rich, configurable, or workflow-intensive products.
  • Experience with compliance, risk, financial services, investigations, or decision-support solutions.
  • Experience designing AI-assisted, generative AI, conversational, or agent-supported experiences.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI principles, including transparency, source visibility, human review, and user control.
  • Experience taking new products from customer discovery through validation and delivery.
  • Familiarity with Agile/lean product development, design systems, and reusable components.

Portfolio Requirement

Submission of a portfolio is required. Please include case studies that demonstrate your approach to understanding customer problems, designing complex product experiences, iterating through research and testing, collaborating with Product Management and Engineering, and carrying design work through implementation.

Do you enjoy turning business challenges into practical learning experiences that help people perform at their best?

Are you excited to partner with leaders and teams to strengthen sales effectiveness, productivity, and leadership capabilities?


About our Team

LexisNexis Legal & Professional, which serves customers in more than 150 countries with 11,800 employees worldwide, is part of RELX ( a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. Our company has been a long-time leader in deploying AI and advanced technologies to the legal market to improve productivity and transform the overall business and practice of law, deploying ethical and powerful generative AI solutions with a flexible, multi-model approach that prioritizes using the best model from today’s top model creators for each individual legal use case. The company employs over 2,000 technologists, data scientists, and experts to develop, test, and validate solutions in line with RELX Responsible AI Principles (


About the Role

As a Performance Consultant, you’ll partner with leaders and teams across North America to create practical learning experiences that improve individual and team performance. You’ll develop solutions that help new hires reach revenue targets sooner, experienced sales representatives sell more effectively, managers strengthen their leadership and coaching skills, and employees in non-sales roles improve productivity and job satisfaction.


Responsibilities

  • Partner with senior leadership to shape and deliver large-scale development initiatives that support business priorities across LexisNexis North America.
  • Consult with sales and segment leaders to identify performance gaps and recommend targeted learning solutions for new hires and experienced employees across multiple functions.
  • Design, plan, and deliver engaging training for large audiences on sales and non-sales topics, both in person and virtually.
  • Create practical tools, guides, and follow-up resources that help employees apply what they learn on the job.
  • Collaborate with subject matter experts to develop relevant content, coordinate training programs, and facilitate effective learning experiences.
  • Measure program effectiveness through participant feedback and performance data, communicate results, and continually improve programs.
  • Apply adult learning principles, effective instructional techniques, and emerging technologies, including generative AI, to strengthen learning and employee productivity.
  • Work across all levels of the sales organization to solve problems and address challenges that affect employee and team performance.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated successful experience in training
  • Strong understanding of the sales process

raw.title: Nurse Practitioner / Physician Assistant / Certified Nurse Midwife
raw.excerpt: About BabyscriptsBabyscripts is a leading innovator in digital maternal health, transforming pregnancy and postpartum care through remote patient monitoring (RPM) and digital engagement.
raw.description:
About Babyscripts

Babyscripts is a leading innovator in digital maternal health, transforming pregnancy and postpartum care through remote patient monitoring (RPM) and digital engagement. Our solutions enable OB providers and health systems to monitor patients in real time, improving access, early intervention, and overall outcomes in maternal-fetal health.

About the Role

We are seeking a Qualified Healthcare Provider (QHCP) — Nurse Practitioner, Physician Assistant, or Certified Nurse Midwife — to join our remote clinical operations team on a fractional or part-time basis.

This role requires active licensure in the state of Texas, as the provider will support patients and clinical partners located in Texas.

In this role, you will leverage your clinical expertise to review vitals data, assess patient communications, and document clinical summaries that support key customer and quality requirements. The QHCP will also participate in targeted patient outreach for elevated readings, symptoms, or follow-up coordination as part of our virtual maternal health model.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced clinician seeking flexible, remote work while contributing meaningfully to a growing digital health company advancing maternal outcomes nationwide.

Time Commitment: Approximately 10–20 hours per week, with flexibility based on business needs and case volume.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor patient data trends (e.g., blood pressure, weight, symptoms) and identify high-risk cases requiring intervention.
  • Perform clinical assessments via phone, telehealth, or messaging to provide education, intervention, and care plan adjustments.
  • Provide direct patient education on managing hypertension, gestational diabetes, preeclampsia risks, postpartum recovery, and other maternal health concerns.
  • Escalate high-risk cases to the appropriate provider per established protocols.
  • Support care coordination by assisting patients with referrals, scheduling follow-ups, and connecting them to additional resources.
  • Ensure compliance with RPM protocols by coaching patients on adherence and addressing barriers to engagement.
  • Document all clinical interactions in Babyscripts' care management platform, ensuring accuracy and compliance with healthcare regulations.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

  • Clinical Data Review: Analyze patient vitals data (e.g., blood pressure, glucose, weight, symptoms) and message histories to identify trends, risk factors, and potential clinical concerns.
  • Clinical Documentation: Create and validate summary notes or Evidence of Care (EoC) reports supporting provider review and quality reporting requirements.
  • Patient Outreach: Conduct focused patient outreach via phone or secure messaging to verify readings, reinforce care plans, or assess for warning signs when needed.
  • Quality Assurance: Ensure data completeness, appropriate clinical coding alignment, and compliance with Babyscripts protocols and payer requirements.
  • Provider Coordination: Escalate abnormal findings or nonresponsive patients per established triage and escalation pathways.
  • Continuous Improvement: Provide clinical feedback to support optimization of Babyscripts’ workflows, triggers, and RPM care logic.

Qualifications

  • Active, unrestricted NP, PA, or CNM license in the state of Texas (required).
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of clinical experience in OB/GYN, women’s health, maternal-fetal medicine, or related fields.
  • Prior experience with remote patient monitoring, telehealth, or population health preferred.
  • Strong ability to synthesize data and communicate concise clinical insights.
  • Comfort navigating EHRs, care management platforms, and digital tools.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Bilingual (Spanish) strongly preferred.

Compensation & Structure

  • Type: Fractional / 1099 or W2 part-time (based on preference and local regulations).
  • Compensation: Competitive hourly or per-review rate, commensurate with experience and licensure.
  • Incentives: Eligible for quality- and performance-based bonuses (documentation accuracy, turnaround time, engagement metrics).
  • Flexibility: Fully remote; scheduling coordinated with the clinical operations lead based on coverage needs.

Note: Part-time employees are not eligible for full-time medical, dental, vision, or 401(k) benefits, but may be eligible for select company perks depending on hours worked and tenure.

Staffing & Coverage Expectations

  • Maintain consistent availability during agreed-upon hours (e.g., 10–20 hrs/week).
  • Communicate any planned time off or coverage changes in advance to maintain patient continuity.
  • Participate in clinical huddles or team updates as scheduled (typically brief and virtual).

Please Note: Applicants must hold an active NP, PA, or CNM license in the state of Texas to be considered for this role. Licensure in additional states is welcome but not required.

raw.description:
Job Description:

DXC Technology (NYSE: DXC) helps global companies run their mission‑critical systems and operations while modernizing IT, optimizing data architectures, and ensuring security and scalability across public, private, and hybrid clouds. The world’s largest companies and public sector organizations trust DXC to deploy services across the Enterprise Technology Stack to drive new levels of performance, competitiveness, and customer experience.


The SAP PP Senior Consultant will be responsible for leading manufacturing transformation initiatives, designing scalable SAP production planning solutions, driving SAP S/4HANA adoption, and partnering with business stakeholders to optimize planning and manufacturing processes across global enterprise environments. The candidate should possess a strong blend of functional expertise, consulting skills, and leadership capabilities to successfully deliver complex SAP programs.


Key Responsibilities

Business Process Consulting

  • Analyze and understand complex manufacturing business requirements.
  • Conduct workshops, fit-gap analysis, and business process assessments.
  • Design and implement best-practice SAP PP solutions aligned with business objectives.
  • Advise stakeholders on process optimization and digital manufacturing strategies.
  • Provide industry-leading recommendations for planning and production processes.

SAP PP Configuration and Implementation

  • Configure and support SAP PP modules including:
    • Demand Management
    • Sales & Operations Planning
    • Material Requirements Planning (MRP)
    • Master Production Scheduling (MPS)
    • Capacity Planning
    • Production Orders
    • Process Orders
    • Shop Floor Control
    • Batch Management
    • Production Execution
    • Repetitive Manufacturing
    • Work Centers
    • Routings
    • Bills of Materials (BOM)
  • Lead implementation activities from blueprint through go-live and hypercare support.
  • Participate in global template design and localization requirements.

SAP S/4HANA Expertise

  • Lead SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA transformation projects.
  • Support migration of manufacturing processes to SAP S/4HANA.
  • Configure and optimize:
    • MRP Live
    • Advanced ATP
    • Embedded Analytics
    • Fiori Applications
    • Production Planning for S/4HANA
    • PP/DS Integration
  • Drive adoption of SAP best practices and simplification items.

Integration Management

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration with:
    • SAP MM
    • SAP SD
    • SAP QM
    • SAP EWM
    • SAP PM
    • SAP FI/CO
    • SAP APO/IBP
    • SAP TM
  • Coordinate end-to-end business process testing across modules.

Project Leadership

  • Lead PP workstreams within large-scale SAP transformation programs.
  • Manage project deliverables, timelines, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Mentor junior consultants and provide technical guidance.
  • Coordinate offshore and onshore teams during implementation activities.
  • Support project governance, risk management, and issue resolution.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of SAP PP consulting experience.
  • Minimum 4 end-to-end SAP implementation projects.
  • Strong experience in SAP S/4HANA Manufacturing and Production Planning.
  • Deep understanding of manufacturing industry processes.
  • Expertise in production planning, scheduling, procurement planning, and manufacturing execution.
  • Strong experience in master data management including BOMs, Routings, Work Centers, and Production Versions.
  • Experience in global delivery and multi-country implementations.
  • Strong client-facing consulting and stakeholder management abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP PP Certification.
  • Experience with SAP PP/DS, SAP IBP, SAP Digital Manufacturing, and Industry 4.0 initiatives.
  • Experience in Automotive, Industrial Manufacturing, Consumer Goods, or Process Industry sectors.
  • Knowledge of SAP Activate methodology and Agile project delivery.
  • Exposure to cloud-based SAP solutions and SAP BTP.


Soft Skills


  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work effectively with global teams and senior leadership.
  • Proven leadership, mentoring, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong documentation and business process mapping capabilities.

Key Competencies

  • SAP Production Planning (PP)
  • SAP S/4HANA Manufacturing
  • MRP & Capacity Planning
  • Production Execution
  • Discrete Manufacturing
  • Process Manufacturing
  • Supply Chain Planning
  • Solution Design
  • Business Transformation
  • Global Template Rollouts
  • Integration Management
  • SAP Best Practices

We’re on a mission to empower people with disabilities to do what they once did or never thought possible. As the world-leader in assistive communication solutions, we empower our customers to express themselves, connect with the world, and live richer lives.

At Tobii Dynavox, you can grow your career within a dynamic, global companythat has a clear, impactful purpose - with the flexibility to also do what truly matters to you outside of work. What’s more, you’ll be part of a work culture where collaboration is the norm and individuality is welcomed.

As a member of our team, you’ll have the power to make it happen. You’ll solve challenges, deliver solutions and develop new, efficient processes that make a direct impact on our customers’ lives.

The Interim Funding Consultant is responsible for coordinating the intake, submission, and follow-up of new product, repair, and equipment rental orders.  This individual works closely with SLPs, government agencies, and educational institutions to obtain order authorization and thoroughly reviews documents for submission ensuring they meet third party payer criteria.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Maintain communication with SLPs on funding cases and instruct SLPs on document preparation and funding policies and regulations
  • Work with insurance providers, government agencies, and educational institutions to place new product, repair or rental orders
  • Track funding authorization cases ensuring requests are resolved to completion in a timely manner
  • Utilize on-line resources and maintain frequent communication with funding agencies to verify eligibility
  • Review prior authorization documents against third party payer criteria
  • Research previous orders and payment history/DSOs for any repair or new order requests
  • Enter and complete orders in the order management system databas
  • Serve as a client advocate by communicating with clients and family members on funding requests and co-payment requirements, representing client’s case with third party insurance providers and troubleshooting any problems to resolution
  • Resolve third party denials and provide consultation to finalize difficult funding cases
  • Alert supervisor of potential third-party payer challenges
  • Perform various other duties as assigned


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:


EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor Degree, or 2 – 4 years related experience
  • Background in the health insurance field preferred

COMMUNICATION SKILLS:

  • Oral and written communication skills
  • Interpersonal, collaboration, and teaming skills
  • Customer service orientation

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS (Continued):

COMPUTER OR TECHNICAL SKILLS:

  • Internet navigation skills
  • MS Office Word and Outlook

OTHER SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Able to multitask in a fast-paced environment

WORK ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENT:

  • Able to work at a desk for prolonged periods of time
  • Ability to work with interruptions in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to travel to the Pittsburgh office for team activities/ trainings (approx. 4 times per year) 

Apply today!

raw.description:
FEP Trainer I-III DOE

Work from home within Washington, Idaho, Oregon, and Utah. Preference will be given to current employees and candidates who reside in Idaho and Utah.

Build a career with purpose. Join our Cause to create a person-focused and economically sustainable health care system.

Who We Are Looking For:

Every day, Cambia’s dedicated team of FEP Trainers is living our mission to make health care easier and lives better. As a member of the Training team, our Trainers research, develop, and deliver operational training; partner with leaders and SMEs to identify learning needs; serve as systems and process experts; and evaluate participant performance – all in service of creating a person-focused health care experience.

Do you enjoy teaching others and helping them build confidence in new skills? Are you energized by solving problems and turning complex processes into clear, practical training? Then this role may be the perfect fit.

What You Bring to Cambia:


Qualifications:


Trainer I:

  • 2 years in operational areas such as customer service, claims, or membership, and/or delivering training in a matrixed environment
  • An equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered

Trainer II:

  • Bachelor's degree in education, communications, or a related field
  • 3 years in operational areas such as customer service, claims, and membership, plus experience delivering training in a matrixed environment
  • An equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered

Trainer III:

  • Bachelor's degree in education, communications, or a related field
  • 4 years in operational areas such as customer service and claims, plus 2 years delivering training in a matrixed environment
  • An equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered

Skills and Attributes:


  • Demonstrated ability to command audience attention while training in person and virtually
  • Demonstrated business writing skills, with strong grammar and sentence structure, to produce clear, concise documentation adaptable to different audiences
  • Strong editing and document design skills
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts into easily understandable documentation
  • Demonstrated competency in analyzing and responding appropriately to problem situations
  • Ability to manage several tasks at once and independently prioritize workload to meet business needs
  • Experience with AI tools and technologies to enhance productivity and decision-making (highly desired)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor content and style to diverse audiences and settings
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, facilitate, motivate, and inspire others to achieve work success and connect their jobs to the company cause
  • Ability to think clearly under pressure and project a professional image
  • Flexibility to work independently or within a team to achieve training goals and deliverables
  • Demonstrated desire to learn and adjust performance based on feedback
  • Strong, effective, and diplomatic interpersonal skills

Additional Skills and Attributes for Trainer II:

  • Skilled in prioritizing work and handling multiple tasks with a focus on accuracy and attention to detail
  • Demonstrated capability in identifying learners' educational needs and adjusting delivery for effective learning
  • Experience building and maintaining interpersonal relationships, managing conflict, and solving problems alongside necessary administrative functions
  • Advanced ability to motivate learners of all levels to meet Operations standards and requirements

Additional Skills and Attributes for Trainer III:

  • Demonstrated ability to assess, design, and develop training curriculum using best practices, including learning theory, learning styles, and writing and measuring effective objectives
  • Superior ability to examine changes to business requirements and incorporate critical updates to ensure high-quality training
  • Proficient at identifying and addressing learners' educational needs to ensure the best possible outcomes
  • Proven ability to cultivate and maintain lasting relationships with business partners to share best practices and identify training needs that support desired outcomes

What You Will Do at Cambia:

  • Develop limited training content, and keep all materials consistent and updated to reflect current practices
  • Deliver Regence operations training in person, virtually, individually, and in groups, using adult learning methods and technology tailored to learning styles, retention, and recall
  • Manage day-to-day classroom activities for a diverse audience, including leading participants, tracking and reporting learner performance, and communicating progress or concerns to business leaders
  • Continuously assess participant performance and conduct routine audits, making real-time adjustments to delivery to ensure knowledge transfer
  • Maintain knowledge of operations systems and changes through job function practice, team meetings, side-by-side observations, and quality or transaction monitoring
  • Stay current on industry updates and best practices, and recommend improvements for implementation
  • Perform other duties as assigned, including project and leadership support
  • FEP-specific: Research, author, and maintain operational content in knowledge management systems, using personal expertise or input from subject matter experts

Additional Responsibilities for Level II:

  • Develop comprehensive training materials for existing practices, ensuring curriculum consistency and timely updates
  • Deliver the full scope of new employee and ongoing training, including individual modules and multi-day or multi-week programs
  • Track and analyze trainee performance, providing timely audits and feedback on complex concepts and adjusting in real time to meet learner needs
  • Consult with business leaders and conduct needs analyses to recommend solutions for identified training needs
  • Provide guidance to Trainer I to support essential skill development

Additional Responsibilities for Level III:

  • Develop training curriculum and materials for new products, processes, and system rollouts, including schedules for development, delivery, and evaluation
  • Track and analyze trainee performance, and partner with Operations leadership to create remediation plans for performance opportunities
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to align learning with business objectives and support continuous improvement
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on cross-functional teams, representing Regence Operations Training in strategic initiatives
  • Mentor and guide Trainer I and II to support continued skill development
  • Provide mentorship in developing and validating training materials, curriculum, and essential skills

Trainer I:


National pay structure — applies to the Boise, Portland, Salem, Seattle/Renton/Tacoma, Burlington, Vancouver, and Salt Lake City metro areas. The full salary range is $24.10 - $39.30 and the bonus target is 5%. The expected salary range is $27.15 - $34.75.

Regional pay structure — applies to North Dakota and to Idaho, Oregon, Washington, and Utah locations outside the metro areas listed above. The full salary range is $21.70 - $35.40 and the bonus target is 5%. The expected salary range is $24.45 - $31.30.

raw.description:
At Connect Centric, we are more than just consultants—we are partners committed to our clients' success. We take a hands-on approach, working closely with our clients to transform strategies into measurable, real-world outcomes. As a strategy execution team, we take full ownership of every initiative from start to finish, ensuring that our clients see tangible results, not just ideas.

Position Description

Connect Centric is seeking a Membership Data SME to lead a strategic data initiative for a national trade association. Over the next six months, you'll partner with the client's marketing and operations leadership to build foundational member data systems, establish sources of truth across disparate platforms, and create a roadmap for long-term data governance.

You'll work across multiple enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, AMS, and supporting applications) to audit current state, identify inconsistencies, and define clear data requirements. Your expertise will directly shape how the organization understands and manages its member relationships. This is hands-on, practical work—not a theoretical exercise. You'll lead the effort and actively partner with internal teams to turn strategy into actionable deliverables.

What You Will Do

Data Strategy and Requirements Definition

  • Lead the design and development of a comprehensive data dictionary covering five core domains: Person/Contact, Organization/Account, Membership & Affiliation, Relationship & Engagement, and Reference & Master Data.

  • Define clear, business-focused data requirements that translate member journey insights and strategic goals into technical specifications for implementation teams.

  • Establish sources of truth and business rules for key data elements, ensuring consistency across multiple systems.

  • Document member journeys, lifecycle stages (join, renew, lapse), member types, and organization-to-contact relationships and affiliations.

System Analysis and Data Integration

  • Assess current state across the client's technology ecosystem: ERP platform, two CRM instances, association management system (AMS), and supporting applications.

  • Identify data gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improved data quality and integration.

  • Lead record matching, data cleanup, and reconciliation efforts across multiple systems.

  • Recommend practical approaches to unify member data without imposing heavyweight or unrealistic frameworks.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Facilitation

  • Facilitate agreement across marketing, operations, IT, and other stakeholders on data definitions, ownership, and accountability.

  • Drive decision-making and closure on critical data governance questions.

  • Translate complex data concepts into member and business terms for non-technical leaders.

  • Assess existing work, clarify ambiguity, and establish practical priorities aligned with organizational readiness.

Knowledge Transfer and Capability Building

  • Establish practical data ownership and stewardship structures that the client team can sustain independently.

  • Transfer expertise to internal team members so they can own, evolve, and manage data governance after the engagement concludes.

  • Document processes, decisions, and lessons learned to support long-term success.

  • Mentor internal staff on data best practices specific to association and membership contexts.

Required Qualifications

  • Significant membership data experience at trade or professional associations—in-house or as a consultant primarily serving associations.

  • Deep working knowledge of member journeys, membership lifecycles (join, renew, lapse), member types, and organization-to-contact relationships and affiliations.

  • Hands-on AMS platform experience (iMIS, Personify, NetForum, Fonteva, or similar), including data cleanup, integration, and migration work.

  • Proven track record building data dictionaries, setting sources of truth and business rules, and leading record matching or reconciliation across multiple systems.

  • Ability to turn business needs into clear data requirements that technical teams can execute.

  • Strong facilitation and stakeholder management skills; ability to drive cross-functional agreement to closure.

  • Comfort with ambiguity; ability to assess existing work and create clarity without a fully defined scope.

  • Demonstrated ability to establish practical data ownership and stewardship structures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in membership data, data strategy, or data governance roles.

  • Experience building data governance frameworks in early-stage or transitional environments.

  • Background in scientific, academic, nonprofit, or professional association organizations.

  • Experience with ERP, CRM, or AMS implementations or migrations.

  • Advanced degree in data management, business administration, or related field.

Position Details

  • Position Type: Project-based contract (independent contractor or 1099). Full-time W-2 employment is not available for this engagement.

  • Allocation: 50–75% (flexible based on project phases and client needs).

  • Duration: Approximately 6 months, with potential extension into the broader data strategy roadmap based on performance and client needs.

  • Location: Virtual (U.S. or international candidates welcome; ability to collaborate during standard U.S. business hours preferred).

  • Start Date: Open.

  • Compensation: Competitive contractor rates based on experience and allocation.

Senior Systems Solutions Architect – Cloud, Virtualization & AI (Remote – California)

Full-Time, Part-Time, or Contract | Competitive Compensation + Professional Development

About GigaKOM

For more than 20 years, GigaKOM has delivered enterprise-level IT solutions to California K–12 school districts, higher education institutions, state and local government agencies, and commercial organizations. Through partnerships with leading manufacturers and technology providers, we design and deliver secure, scalable infrastructure solutions that support mission-critical environments.

As organizations continue modernizing their infrastructure, cloud platforms, identity, and data capabilities, GigaKOM is expanding its architecture and consulting capabilities. We are seeking a Senior Systems Solutions Architect to design, support, and optimize enterprise environments across Microsoft cloud services, virtualization systems, enterprise infrastructure, and emerging AI-driven technologies.

This role combines solution architecture, systems engineering, client consulting, and ongoing infrastructure support to help organizations modernize, secure, and optimize their IT environments.

Location

Remote – California

This is a fully remote position supporting client environments across California.

Position Overview

The Senior Systems Solutions Architect is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting modern enterprise infrastructure solutions that integrate cloud services, virtualization platforms, AI-enabled technologies, identity and access management, and core enterprise systems.

This role works closely with sales teams, engineers, and client stakeholders to evaluate current environments, architect scalable solutions, support client infrastructure, and guide organizations through modernization initiatives.

In addition to solution design, this position will support client systems, troubleshoot infrastructure issues, and ensure optimal performance, security, and reliability across deployed environments.

The ideal candidate is both a strategic architect and a hands-on technologist with deep experience across Microsoft technologies (Azure, Microsoft Entra ID), virtualization platforms, and enterprise server environments.

What You’ll Do

Design Cloud, Identity & Hybrid Infrastructure Solutions

  • Architect and design hybrid and cloud solutions using Microsoft Azure and related services
  • Design and implement identity and access solutions using Microsoft Entra ID (authentication, SSO, conditional access, MFA)
  • Develop infrastructure strategies supporting scalability, resilience, and security
  • Guide organizations through cloud migration, modernization, and optimization initiatives
  • Design high-availability architectures for mission-critical workloads

Data Center Solution Design & Architecture

  • Lead the design of end-to-end, enterprise-grade data center solutions that are scalable, secure, resilient, and cost-optimized across compute, storage, networking, virtualization, backup, and hybrid/multi-cloud environments.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into future-ready architecture, aligning solutions with client digital transformation goals, operational models, and long-term technology strategies.
  • Architect and integrate multi-vendor solutions leveraging Cisco, HPE, Dell EMC, VMware, Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Veeam, ensuring seamless interoperability and optimal technology selection.
  • Develop high-level and low-level designs (HLD/LLD), architecture diagrams, and solution blueprints covering scalability, performance, availability, and integration points.
  • Ensure alignment with industry best practices, security standards, and vendor reference architectures, while optimizing total cost of ownership (TCO) and risk mitigation.
  • Incorporate hybrid cloud, automation, and modern infrastructure principles (HCI, SDDC, orchestration) to enhance agility, operational efficiency, and service reliability.

Virtualization & Modern Infrastructure Design

  • Architect virtualization platforms including VMware and Hyper-V (and related tooling)
  • Design solutions for compute, storage, backup/recovery, and enterprise server infrastructure
  • Support modernization of legacy systems into hybrid or cloud environments
  • Optimize performance and resource utilization across virtualized environments

AI & Advanced Technology Integration

  • Evaluate opportunities to integrate AI-driven services, automation, and intelligent data platforms
  • Design infrastructure capable of supporting AI-related workloads, analytics, and modern applications
  • Consult with clients on AI readiness, governance considerations, and infrastructure requirements
  • Integrate automation capabilities into enterprise IT strategies

Client Infrastructure Support

  • Support deployed infrastructure solutions for client environments
  • Troubleshoot issues related to servers, virtualization platforms, storage, identity, and cloud services
  • Monitor system health and implement updates, patches, and performance optimizations
  • Ensure system security, reliability, and availability across client environments
  • Provide technical guidance and escalation support to clients and internal teams

Client Consulting & Technical Leadership

  • Conduct discovery sessions to understand business and technical requirements
  • Develop architecture diagrams, solution documentation, and implementation strategies
  • Present technical recommendations to CIOs, IT Directors, and executive stakeholders
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor guiding long-term technology roadmaps

Collaboration & Solution Development

  • Partner with sales teams on solution architecture and technical validation
  • Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, and strategic technology planning
  • Support proof-of-concept initiatives and pilot deployments
  • Work closely with engineering teams to ensure successful implementation

Documentation & Continuous Innovation

  • Develop technical documentation, architecture guides, and operational procedures
  • Monitor emerging technologies in cloud services, virtualization, identity, and AI platforms
  • Recommend improvements and modernization opportunities for client environments
  • Contribute to internal best practices and knowledge sharing

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 6+ years of experience designing and supporting enterprise IT infrastructure solutions
  • Strong expertise with Microsoft technologies, including Windows Server and Microsoft Azure
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including identity governance and security controls
  • Experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware and/or Hyper-V
  • Experience supporting enterprise servers, storage, backup/recovery, and hybrid environments
  • Strong understanding of system architecture, networking fundamentals, and security best practices
  • Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and documentation skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Preferred

  • Experience supporting California SLED (State, Local Government, and Education) clients
  • Certifications such as Microsoft Azure Architect, Microsoft identity/security certifications, VMware certifications, or equivalent
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale or multi-client environments

Core Competencies

  • Enterprise systems architecture and infrastructure design
  • Microsoft cloud services and hybrid environment strategy
  • Identity and access management (Microsoft Entra ID)
  • Virtualization and infrastructure modernization
  • AI and automation integration planning
  • Client consulting and executive communication
  • Infrastructure troubleshooting and support
  • Technical documentation and architecture planning
  • Strategic problem-solving and solution optimization

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation based on experience
  • Flexible engagement options:
    • Full-time
    • Part-time
    • Contract
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Training and certification support

This position is created specifically to assist with Humana’s efforts to secure and, if awarded, transition into a new business opportunity. In the event Humana does not pursue the opportunity or determines that a timely and satisfactory transition cannot be achieved, employment may be subject to termination.

The Business Intelligence Lead is responsible for leading data and analytics efforts in support of the VA Contact Center, with a focus on transforming data from CRM, telephony, quality management, workforce management, and related operational systems into actionable business intelligence. This role oversees the tools, technologies, applications, and practices used to collect, integrate, analyze, interpret, and present data to drive informed decision-making, improve operational performance, and support strategic outcomes across the contact center environment.

This position partners closely with VA Contact Center leadership, Enrollment leadership, Operations, and IT to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and performance improvement actions based on data analysis. The Business Intelligence Lead is expected to provide insight into key contact center performance drivers such as call volume, average speed of answer, service level, abandonment, first contact resolution, quality, productivity, member experience, and other operational and outcome-based measures. This role synthesizes large and complex data sets into clear recommendations and delivers analysis that enables leadership to make timely, data-driven decisions on matters of significance.

The Business Intelligence Lead also collaborates with business and technical partners to identify, evaluate, and advance AI, automation, and robotic process automation (RPA) opportunities that improve contact center efficiency, effectiveness, and user experience. This includes supporting initiatives from opportunity assessment and business case development through implementation, adoption, and post-deployment benefit validation.

In addition, this role serves as a strategic advisor to operational leadership by developing and informing contact center functional strategies that align with broader enterprise objectives. The individual uses advanced analytical methods, business acumen, and operational knowledge to assess variable factors, identify root causes, forecast impacts, and recommend the best course of action. The role frequently advises leadership on high-impact issues where data analysis is essential to decision-making, including workforce planning, service performance, process improvement, technology optimization, and operational readiness.

The Business Intelligence Lead exercises independent judgment and decision-making on complex assignments and works under minimal supervision. This role is expected to lead through influence, communicate findings effectively to technical and non-technical audiences, and ensure that decisions are grounded in accurate, meaningful, and actionable data.

Our Government Contract Requires US Citizenship for this Position

  • Proven ability to work with cross-functional teams and translate requirements between business, project management and technical projects or programs
  • Proficiency in understanding Healthcare related data
  • Proficiency in verbal/written communication to senior and executive leadership
  • Must be passionate about contributing to an organization focused on continuously improving consumer experiences

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

REMOTE / WORK FROM HOME POSITION
Before applying, please note:
The entire application process must be completed in English. Fluent written and spoken English is required and will be evaluated.
Applicants must be independent freelancers, not represented by another agency, and currently based outside the United States.
WHO ARE WE? FOUNTAIN FORWARD
We are a hyper-motivated crew of internet marketing experts based in Houston, Texas. We're on a mission to provide truly profitable data-driven marketing solutions, primarily for The Automotive industry.
We love working together to accomplish one thing: persuade people to do business with our clients, and do it more often. Seeing our clients make more money and collaborating together to accomplish their goals is what drives us to slam down a couple of espressos every morning and fire up our brain cells.
Job Overview / Purpose Statement
The Full Stack Developer builds, improves, and maintains web applications, platforms, and tools that power Fountain Forward’s services. This role works across front-end and back-end technologies, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with business requirements. Developers collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver integrations, automation, and performance improvements.
Responsibilities & Duties
Core Development:
  • Build and maintain full-stack applications using modern frameworks (Next.js and FastAPI).
  • Write clean, efficient Python scripts for automation, integration, or data handling.
  • Develop and document RESTful APIs for internal and external integrations.
  • Design and manage relational databases (PostgreSQL).
Integration & Tooling:
  • Integrate with third-party tools and services (Slack, Google Drive, ClickUp, CRMs).
  • Implement integrations with external APIs and services.
  • Build internal tools that support scalability and workflow efficiency.
Performance, Quality & Maintenance:
  • Optimize application performance, security, and scalability.
  • Debug, test, and maintain code to ensure reliability and stability.
  • Troubleshoot, upgrade, and improve existing software.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  • Work with stakeholders to translate needs into technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with analysts, operations, and sales teams to ensure systems align with business goals.
Innovation & Continuous Improvement:
  • Develop functional applications with modern JavaScript frameworks (Next.js).
  • Stay updated with emerging technologies and best practices; recommend improvements.
  • The team member must be present and actively participate in all FF training sessions they are invited to attend. If unable to attend, they are responsible for reviewing the training materials and catching up on any missed training.

Requirements

Required Skills & Qualifications
Responsibilities & Duties:
1+ years in full-stack development roles.
Strong proficiency with Next.js, and backend best practices with FastAPI.

Quality Control & Oversight:
Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Ability to debug, troubleshoot, and optimize applications.

Analytics & Reporting:
Proficiency with Python for automation and backend scripting.
Ability to integrate and report on system performance.

Process & Project Management:
Experience in API integration, database design (Supabase / PostgreSQL), and cloud deployment (GCP and Railway).

Mentorship & Training:
Excellent communication skills in English; ability to share technical knowledge clearly.

Collaboration:
Strong teamwork with stakeholders and cross-department peers to align technical work with business objectives.
Preferred Experience & Competencies
Must be proficient in English (written and verbal)
Strong problem-solving, quantitative, and analytical abilities.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and delegation skills.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
Knowledge of AI/ML integration basics.
Ability to work independently and align with a remote team in CST hours
OUR HIRING PROCESS
1. Application Review
2. Initial Interview
3. Skills Assessment
4. Final Interview

Benefits

How We Work
  • Freedom and flexibility. We’re a team working from around the world. That is, as long as they show up on our weekly calls, do their job correctly, and have a good sense of accountability.
  • Autonomy and ownership. Working on a distributed team means you don’t have someone micromanaging you or looking over your shoulder to make sure you’re getting things done. We’re a team of do-ers who take full ownership for their results.
  • Be helpful and dedicated. We help our clients be successful. We help our prospects get the right information and make the right decision whether or not it includes our services. We help our team members reach their full potential.
The Perks!
  • Remote-First Culture: Work from home—or anywhere in the world. We value results, not where you log in from.
  • Flexible Schedule: We offer flexibility in your daily schedule (within reason) to help you do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off: Enjoy an unlimited vacation policy with just two weeks’ notice and manager approval. We also offer paid sick days because your well-being matters.
  • Parental Leave: We understand the importance of supporting our team members during significant life events. Our maternity and paternity leave policy ensures you can prioritize your growing family without added stress.
  • Room to Grow: We’re a fast-growing company with massive opportunities for upward mobility. As we grow, you grow with us.
  • Professional Development: Get access to training in digital marketing, advertising, and leadership to sharpen your skills and advance your career.
  • Quarterly Performance Bonuses: Earn bonuses based on your performance and contributions to the company’s success.
  • Paid Referral Program: Earn rewards for referring great talent to join our team!
  • Health & Fitness Reimbursement (upon tenure): Get support for health insurance or a gym membership—because your well-being matters.
