Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Sales Specialist Manager, Loyalty IssuersOverview
Mastercard Services is our professional services and solutions arm, providing customers with value-added services to enhance business performance and consumer experiences. Our diverse Services portfolio includes loyalty solutions, marketing, media, personalization and much more.

The Services Business Development team is looking for a Loyalty Sales Specialist to drive growth of our value-added services within the Issuer space. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of selling to senior executives, navigating matrixed organizations, and utilizing solution-based selling to drive clear value for customers.

Role

As Manager, Specialist Sales you will be responsible for generating new loyalty platform sales within the financial services segment in North America.
• Strong working knowledge of the financial services ecosystem, payment solutions, and an understanding of the value propositions for acquisition, retention and usage campaigns.
Responsible for developing and executing the sales strategy for a key set of prospect accounts within the region to secure multimillion-dollar, multi-year deals
• Build and develop an active pipeline, ultimately progressing to signed platform deals
• Articulate the benefits of bundling our Loyalty Solutions products with other Data & Services products (Consulting, Managed Services, Test & Learn, Customer Data Enhancement, Labs as a Service, etc.)
• Strong communication and influencing skills, should be a compelling presenter to senior client audiences and able to influence large deals
• Ability to seamlessly partner across our multiple internal sales, product management, program management and finance teams.
• Excellent problem solving and analytics skills and should be able to go head to head with internal stakeholders and customers alike with fact-based thinking
• Will serve as the face of Mastercard D&S to senior level client stakeholders, including c-suite

All About You
• Deep understanding of the suite of Mastercard Data & Services value propositions with a thoughtful approach to executing within and across markets
• Strong commercial drive with ability to build and monetize senior client relationships based on empathy, thought leadership and subject matter expertise
• Strategic software sales experience with expertise in CRM / Martech / Loyalty/Media
• Never give up attitude, excellent at ‘pounding the pavement’ through email/phone cold outreach
• progressively complex hunting sales preferably within Financial Services Segment; rolodex of C-Level / EVP / SVP/VP contacts preferred
• Ability to thrive and build robust pipeline with limited lead generation support
• Strong networker across relevant stakeholder base with the ability to listen, build common ground and influence in order to effectively advance business opportunities and generate revenues

This is a remote position. Candidates must reside and be licensed in one of the following states: Arizona, Florida, Indiana, Ohio or Pennsylvania.


Training is approximately 8-weeks. During the training period, the hours will either be Monday through Friday 8:30 am - 5 pm ET or 9 am - 5:30 pm ET.


Once training is completed, schedules will be assigned per your placement.

**Candidates must be able to commit to the training and future schedules for both positions.

Consult: Monday through Friday

• AZ: 11:30 AM – 8:00 PM ET (Winter 9:30 AM – 6:00 PM AZT/ Summer 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM AZT)

• FL/IN/OH/PA: 11:30 am – 8 pm ET

• For all states:

  • There will also be 1-evening shift per week from 2:30 pm -11 pm ET
  • A Saturday rotation every 4-weeks (10 am - 6:30 pm ET). When working a Saturday shift there would be a weekday off.

Offline: Monday through Friday

• AZ: 11:30 AM – 8:00 PM ET (Winter 9:30 AM – 6:00 PM AZT/ Summer 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM AZT)

• FL/IN/OH/PA: 3 day shifts 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM ET and 2 late shifts 11:30 AM – 8:00 PM EST

• For all states:

  • There will also be a Saturday rotation every other week (8:30 am-5 pm ET for FL/IN/OH/PA or 11:30 am-8 pm ET for AZ). When working a Saturday shift there would be a weekday off.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Staff Pharmacist interprets physicians’ prescriptions, contacts doctors or other prescribers and/or patients to verify information on prescriptions and expedite processing of order. The Staff Pharmacist may track order status and outstanding issues as well as consult with patients regarding the use of medications and potential drug interactions. This individual may take calls from customers regarding lost orders or dispensing errors, maintain daily production, quality and service levels, vary work priorities and activities to accommodate business needs. The Staff Pharmacist may also train less experienced pharmacists.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Consult with patients regarding the use of medications and potential drug interactions. Contact physicians for new and/or transfer authorization. Collaborate with physicians to convert prescriptions to generic or preferred drugs whenever possible. Interpret physicians’ or prescribers’ prescriptions. Contact doctors and/or patients to verify information on prescriptions such as drug strength, prescription sig., and drug name in order to expedite processing of orders. Provide oversight and quality assurance to pharmacy technicians. Verify and confirm validity of controlled substances. Verify prescription information entered in the system by data entry or order entry. Back up other pharmacists as needed, perform additional duties as assigned by management, or train less experienced pharmacists.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy required, PharmD preferred
  • Current active resident pharmacist license in good standing.
  • Advanced problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with other departments to resolve issues.
  • Good oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to read and interpret prescriptions.
  • Strong focus on customer service, quality and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage timelines and meet tight client deadlines.
  • Ability to adapt in a changing environment.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule for peak volume times.
If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.For this position, we anticipate offering an hourly rate of 54 - 91 USD / hourly, depending on relevant factors, including experience and geographic location.

This role is also anticipated to be eligible to participate in an annual bonus plan.


At The Cigna Group, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive range of benefits, with a focus on supporting your whole health. Starting on day one of your employment, you’ll be offered several health-related benefits including medical, vision, dental, and well-being and behavioral health programs. We also offer 401(k), company paid life insurance, tuition reimbursement, a minimum of 18 days of paid time off per year, paid holidays, and leaves of absence. For more details on our employee benefits programs, click here.

raw.description:
Job Description: Revenue Cycle Manager, Integrated Complex Care Associates

About the role

The Billing Manager is the first full-time hire for Integrated Complex Care Associates (ICC) and owns billing, provider enrollment, and billing compliance for the group. You will review and release every claim ICC sends to Medicare, enroll and support the physicians who join, and be the person physician offices and patients call with billing questions.

ICC is a California physician group serving patients with complex health needs, led by each patient's own primary physician. Physicians across California join ICC while keeping their own practices, and ICC bills Medicare for that work under its own group TIN.

What you'll do

Enroll and onboard physicians

  • Own provider enrollment: each physician's 855I reassignment to ICC, ICC's 855B practice locations, PECOS and NPPES updates, revalidations, and Medicare EFT and remittance setup.
  • Set up each physician's office to submit ICC patients' claims through ICC's payer ID, and confirm the first claims flow end to end.
  • Keep ICC's provider roster current as physicians join or leave, including who each physician is paid through.

Support physicians and their offices

  • Be the main billing contact for each physician's office: answer questions, run short onboarding sessions, and fix submission problems quickly.
  • Walk physicians through their payment reports and how ICC's payments relate to their own practice's billing.

Review and release claims

  • Review every claim before it goes to Medicare. Claims arrive from each physician's own practice system through ICC's payer ID, and ICC's system fills in ICC's TIN, the rendering physician's NPI, and the service location in the Stedi billing portal.
  • Check each claim's CPT/HCPCS codes, modifiers, place of service, units, and diagnosis codes, then approve it, correct it, or send it back to the physician's office.
  • Release approved claims to Medicare (Noridian, Jurisdiction E) under ICC's TIN, and track every claim to payment or denial.

Coding quality

  • Sample claims regularly against the physician's EMR of record (ICC patients only) to confirm the documentation supports what was billed, and track error rates by physician.
  • Use Nightingale's HCC view to spot conditions that may be undocumented. Where the record may support one, send the physician a compliant, non-leading query, and code only what the physician documents.
  • Give physicians and their staff short, specific coding feedback, and escalate patterns to ICC's physician leadership.

Payments and denials

  • Post and reconcile Medicare remittances (835s), work rejections and denials, and file corrections, reopenings, and appeals.
  • Answer physicians' and office staff's questions about specific claims, remittance status, and payment reports.
  • Reconcile what Medicare pays ICC with what ICC pays each physician or physician's practice.

Support patients

  • Call each patient before their first ICC claim goes out to explain how ICC's name will appear on their Medicare statements and whom to call with questions.
  • Answer patients' billing questions and resolve their concerns, working with the physician's office as needed.

Run billing compliance

  • Screen every rendering physician and billing staff member monthly against the OIG exclusion list and SAM.
  • Maintain ICC's billing and coding policies, document audits, and report findings to ICC's physician leadership.
  • Identify, report, and return Medicare overpayments within the federal 60-day rule.
  • Use access to physicians' EMRs only for ICC patients and only as much as each task needs, under HIPAA.

Reporting

You'll be employed by Integrated Complex Care MSO LLC, which provides management services to ICC and handles your employment, pay, and day-to-day administration. For coding, billing, and compliance decisions, you'll work under the direction of ICC's physician leadership (Kaushik Patel, MD) and follow ICC's approved billing and coding policies. Questions about what a physician documented go to that physician, and the final say on how a service is billed rests with ICC.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of Medicare Part B professional billing for physician groups, including claim review, denials, and appeals.
  • Hands-on Medicare provider enrollment: PECOS, 855I reassignments, 855B group enrollment, and revalidations.
  • A current coding credential: CPC or CPB (AAPC) or CCS-P (AHIMA). CRC (risk adjustment) preferred.
  • Working knowledge of ICD-10-CM, CPT/HCPCS, modifiers, and documentation standards for HCC risk adjustment.
  • Claims management experience through a clearinghouse or billing portal: submissions, rejections, and remittances (837P, 277CA, 835).
  • Billing compliance experience: audits, exclusion screening, overpayment refunds, and HIPAA.
  • Familiarity with Medicare ACO programs (MSSP, ACO REACH, or LEAD) a plus.
  • Clear, patient phone and writing skills with physicians, office staff, and older patients; Spanish a plus.
  • Comfort as a first hire: building processes from scratch and working independently.

Location, pay, and logistics

  • Location: remote within California; you must live in California. Pacific time business hours, with occasional travel to physician offices around the state.
  • Pay: $95,000+ base salary, depending on experience and location. Full-time, exempt.
  • Benefits: [Savanna fill in Florence standard benefits]
  • Screening: offers are contingent on a background check after a conditional offer, an OIG and SAM exclusion check, and HIPAA training before system access.
  • Equal opportunity: Integrated Complex Care MSO LLC is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in line with the California Fair Chance Act.

At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:
• Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.
• Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.
• Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.
Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data-driven insights – technology plays an invaluable role in our success. The engineering team at Warner Music Group makes all of it a reality. Check out first-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog!
WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.
Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

The Role

Music is driven by fans, and our data tells their story. We’re looking for a passionate Data Scientist to dive into the massive cultural waves happening across major streaming platforms.

In this role you’ll be translating billions of signals into the heartbeat of our listeners. Using advanced statistical methods and machine learning, you’ll uncover hidden listener behaviors, build predictive models for artist and commercial performance, and forecast what fans want next. You’ll also measure and optimize the impact of our global marketing campaigns, using experimentation and data driven insights to understand what truly drives engagement.

If you’re excited to turn complex data into cultural insight and real world impact, this is the place for you.

What You'll Do

  • Advanced Forecasting & Modeling: Build robust forecasting models across streaming, audience growth, and commercial performance. Support comprehensive forecasting efforts across deal risk, merchandise, and demand planning.

  • Audience Insights & Analytics: Gather and analyze audience data to establish best practices for capturing music listening preferences. Detect anomalies and surface actionable insights from large-scale streaming and engagement data.

  • Hypothesis Testing & Storytelling: Transform complex data into compelling stories via tailor-made presentations. Develop new hypothesis testing frameworks and decision-making tools for the real-time assessment of audience viewing patterns and music delivery streams.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with local affiliates, labels, international teams, and Global Technology. You will also collaborate closely with our merchandising teams and business stakeholders to deliver critical reporting and inference.

  • Data Engineering Integration: Interact directly with data engineering teams to identify, define, and secure the data needs required for your mathematical models.

Who You Are

  • Education: Master's degree (or foreign equivalent) in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, or a highly related quantitative field.

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on DS experience post-BS, or 3+ years of post-Graduate Degree hands-on DS experience

  • Technical Stack: 5+ years of hands-on experience working with R, Python, and SQL.

  • Forecasting: At least 5 years of experience building forecasting models across streaming, audience growth, and commercial performance, including evaluating forecast accuracy and continuously improving performance through testing, backtesting, and iteration.

  • Marketing & Audience Models: At least 5 years of experience using advertising data to build marketing mix models (measuring the incremental impact of ads/campaigns using techniques like multi-linear regression and Hierarchical Bayes).

  • Targeting & Behavior: At least 5 years of experience building targeting models, including propensity scoring and look-alike modeling, to develop actionable insights into audience behavior.

  • Production ML: At least 5 years of experience successfully deploying machine learning models into a production environment.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Proven ability to bridge the gap between technical complexity and business logic, serving as a strategic partner who empowers non-technical teams and leadership to make data-driven decisions.

  • Data Visualization: At least 5 years of experience communicating complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders using data visualizations (e.g., matplotlib, ggplot2, or similar libraries).

As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.
Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.
Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.
Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.

Role Summary

The Web Application Firewall Engineeris responsible for developing, evaluating and managing systems security across the enterprise. This role will work closely with the application development teams to assess applications in development as well as in production. The Web Application Firewall Engineer will help safeguard applications and data from threats and define and drive the implementation of these capabilities.


Primary Responsibilities - How will you help us Grow!

  • Configure, tune, test, and optimize Web Application Firewall (WAF) policies and rules to protect web applications and APIs from threats such as OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, automated attacks, malicious payloads, and suspicious traffic patterns.
  • Monitor WAF alerts, application traffic, and security events to identify threats, investigate anomalies, reduce false positives, and recommend appropriate remediation actions.
  • Partner with application development, infrastructure, cloud, and network teams to understand application behavior, define security requirements, and implement WAF controls with minimal business disruption.
  • Assists in the development and implementation of security policies and procedures.
  • Instrumental in data security, regulatory compliance, DDoS mitigation, application protection, and threat detection.
  • Prepares status reports on security matters to develop security risk analysis scenarios and response procedures.
  • Enforces security policies and procedures by administering and monitoring security profiles, reviews security violation reports and investigates possible security exceptions, updates, and maintains and documents security controls.
  • Involved in the evaluation of products and/or procedures to enhance productivity and effectiveness.
  • Provides direct support to the business and IT staff for systems security related issues.
  • Participates in on-call to support WAF operations, respond to security events, troubleshoot urgent production issues, and coordinate timely escalation or remediation as needed.

Education and Experience – What you will bring to the table!

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred.
  • 7–10 years of experience with WAF technologies and/or networking.
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise WAF platforms such as Akamai, Cloudflare, F5, Imperva, or Azure/AWS WAF.
  • Deep understanding of OWASP Top 10, API security, bot mitigation, DDoS protection, and web application attack patterns.
  • Experience tuning WAF rules, reducing false positives, and balancing security controls with application availability.
  • Knowledge of HTTP/S, TLS, DNS, CDN, reverse proxy, load balancing, and web application architectures.
  • Experience partnering with application, infrastructure, cloud, and security operations teams to onboard and protect applications.
  • Familiarity with SIEM/SOAR integrations, logging, alerting, incident response, and threat detection workflows.Ability to document standards, operational procedures, exceptions, and risk-based decisions.
  • Preferred certifications could include CISSP, CSSLP, GIAC, AWS/Azure security, or vendor-specific WAF certifications.
  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills and the ability to develop processes and methodologies.
  • Ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies.
  • Ability to prioritize work to meet tight deadlines and customer needs.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with strong oral, written, and presentation skills.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Aperçu de l’entreprise

Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Nos solutions favorisent la collaboration essentielle pour améliorer la sécurité des populations, des écoles, des hôpitaux, des entreprises et, finalement, des nations. Connectez-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.


Department Overview

D-Fend Solutions, a Motorola Solutions Inc. company, values its employees as our greatest asset. Our professionals and subject matter experts, including personnel from elite military intelligence technology units, provide the best possible solutions to leading customers around the world. We are proud of our impressive presence across different environments and industries, as well as the results we have helped our customers achieve in contending with their counter-drone challenges.

In addition to professional expertise, D-Fend Solutions seeks candidates who thrive in a fast-moving, innovative and collaborative culture. It helps if you enjoy having fun – our “D-Fenders” are a light-hearted bunch who have stashed rubber ducks all around our headquarters.

Are you interested in working with the world’s leading cyber-takeover counter-drone technology provider?

Join D-Fend Solutions in helping to make the world a safer place by addressing emerging challenges in the dynamic and exciting counter-drone arena!


Job Description

The Presales Engineer will assist sales managers in qualifying customer technical requirements, demonstrating the technical and operational features of the D-Fend product line, and answer all questions related to D-Fend's products to the satisfaction of the customers. The Presales Engineer will ensure proper handover of information to the Professional Services Team to prepare them for the client engagement and project implementation by sharing knowledge gained about the customer environment, systems, and risk profile. The Presales Engineer will also carry lessons learned from their activities and present these to the relevant product teams to supply input for the strategic direction of the product line.


Specific Duties & Activities:

  • Product demonstration and presentation. Prepare, present, and demonstrate Company's products to prospective customers
  • Conduct Proof-of Concepts (POCs) and relevance field trials
  • Work and communicate efficiently with the customer, internal teams, and other external interfaces to provide the best product demonstration to the customer
  • Communicate all technical and operational features and benefits of the Company's products to the customer
  • Enable new sales opportunities by constantly collecting information on new customer requirements, changes in the field of c-UAV/counter drones, and potential competitors
  • Other duties assigned by D-Fend's management from time to time

Qualifications:

  • Bachelors Degree is preferred
  • 5+ years of experience in Sales, Engineering or Solutions Architecture
  • Strong written and oral communications skills with the ability to present complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Ability to build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Willingness to think out of the box and challenge the status quo
  • Attention to detail and a flawless execution mindset



Basic Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Sales, Engineering or Solutions Architecture

25-50%

None

Experienced

No

Meet the Team

Join a dynamic group of technical sales professionals dedicated to representing the Cisco brand and delivering impactful solutions to our customers and partners. As a vital part of the account team, you will collaborate with connected sales units to ensure long-term customer success through strategic planning and innovation. The team functions as a trusted advisor, bridging the gap between complex business needs and Cisco’s diverse technology portfolio to drive market penetration. You will have the unique opportunity to lead virtual support teams and provide direct feedback to Business Entities, helping to shape future market opportunities. This role offers an exciting environment where you can influence strategic priorities and displace competition within the Richmond territory.

Your Impact

Drive growth by pinpointing new opportunities and aligning technical strategies directly with customer business objectives. Lead high-level solution conversations with technical executives to promote cross-architecture designs and drive innovation. Execute demand generation and enablement campaigns to address underlying customer challenges and differentiate Cisco solutions from the competition. Conduct technical demonstrations that illustrate how specific products solve business hurdles to increase revenue and expand market share. Mentor extended sales teams to strengthen collective knowledge and guide structured educational initiatives across the organization.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 7+ years of related experience
  • Experience in technical sales or serving as a technical advisor for enterprise customers and partners
  • Proficiency in Cisco's technology portfolio and cross-architectural solution design.
  • Experience leading the technical sales process from opportunity identification through to closing deals
  • Background in competitive market analysis and displacement strategies within enterprise accounts.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of pre-sales experience
  • Ability to translate complex business needs into clear technical requirements for diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership skills to motivate and guide virtual support and extended sales teams.
  • Experience providing strategic feedback to Business Entities regarding market trends and customer needs.
  • Proven track record of influencing strategic priorities for C-suite and technical executives.
  • Adaptability to evolve strategies in response to shifting market conditions and competitive tactics.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

The starting salary range posted for this position is $202,400.00 to $257,900.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits.

Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.

U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

  • 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees

  • 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco

  • Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees

  • Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)

  • 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next

  • Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members

  • Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

  • .75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;

  • 1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%;

  • 1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and

  • Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

raw.title: Phlebotomist Senior Team Lead
raw.excerpt: Getlabs is the leading platform for at-home diagnostics.
raw.description:
Getlabs is the leading platform for at-home diagnostics.
Healthcare organizations use Getlabs to send mobile phlebotomists to patients’ homes and collect labs, vitals, and advanced diagnostics. By leveraging Getlabs, partners can improve patient adherence and close gaps in care with same-day, nationwide availability.
Our team has raised $50M from strategic investors including the two largest diagnostic laboratories in the United States, Labcorp and Quest. Getlabs’ mission is to save lives by expanding access to diagnostics for everyone.
The Phlebotomist Senior Team Lead oversees operational performance, quality compliance, and leadership development across a multi-market region. Building on the Team Lead foundation, this role leads, coaches, and holds accountable a group of phlebotomists and shift leads, serving as the escalation point above the Team Lead level, if supervisor is unavailable. Operating under Leader Standard Work (LSW), the Senior Team Lead maintains clinical competency with a reduced patient appointment load, shifting focus from daily execution to regional coverage strategy, performance trend analysis, process improvement, and partnership with Operations Management.

THIS IS A REMOTE POSITION!

This position is currently limited to candidates residing within a 20-30 mile radius of San Francisco, CA.

At Getlabs, you will:

    Team Lead Leadership & Development

  • Directly supervise, coach, and develop assigned teams; conduct weekly 1:1s and monthly performance check-ins.

  • Audit Team adherence to Leader Standard Work, the 20/24 Rule, and call-out procedures; provide feedback and corrective coaching as needed.

  • Train and certify new Team on LSW, routing, payroll/triplog audits, and quality assessment standards.

  • Identify high-potential phlebotomists and build a succession pipeline for future Team Lead roles.

    • Regional Operations & Escalation Management

  • Serve as the Tier 2 escalation point for operational, clinical, and patient issues that Team Leads cannot resolve within the 20/24 Rule.

  • Own weekly regional coverage planning, including PRN pool strategy, cross-market staffing, and capacity forecasting for upcoming demand.

  • Review Team route optimization and next-day coverage plans; intervene on high-risk markets to protect availability and reschedule targets.

  • Provide final review and sign-off on Team Payroll, Triplog, timecard, and expense submissions before payroll deadlines.

  • Oversee regional inventory and equipment budgets; analyze supply usage trends and approve purchase orders and new hire equipment requests.

    • Quality, Performance Analysis & Process Improvement

  • Analyze regional quality and performance data (redraws, critical errors, NPS, reschedules) to identify trends and root causes; build and track action plans with Team.

  • Calibrate venipuncture assessments and SOP audits across Team to ensure consistent quality standards across markets.

  • Lead formal corrective action and performance improvement plans in partnership with HR and Operations Management; review Team -issued corrective actions for consistency.

  • Identify process gaps and recommend SOP, training, and workflow improvements; pilot and roll out approved changes across the region.

  • Prepare and present regional performance reports to Operations Management on a weekly and monthly cadence.

    • Hiring, Onboarding & Training Strategy

  • Partner with Recruiting on regional hiring needs; conduct final-round interviews and make hiring recommendations.

  • Own the regional onboarding and training plan, ensuring Team Leads deliver consistent new hire onboarding, ride-alongs, and field training.

  • Develop and deliver advanced clinical and leadership training for Team Leads and senior phlebotomists.

    • Shared Supervisor Duties

  • Serve as acting supervisor during Operations Supervisor PTO, absences, and peak periods, with authority to make same-day staffing, scheduling, and escalation decisions.

  • Approve time-off requests, schedule changes, and overtime for phlebotomists within established guidelines.

  • Co-lead performance reviews for phlebotomists and Shift Leads, providing documented feedback and development goals.

  • Partner with the Supervisor and HR on documenting and delivering written warnings and final corrective actions, in line with company policy.

  • Address employee relations concerns at the first level and escalate to the Supervisor or HR when appropriate.

  • Ensure regional compliance with OSHA, HIPAA, and state phlebotomy regulations; lead incident reporting and follow-up for needlesticks, specimen loss, and patient complaints.

  • Represent the region in supervisor and leadership meetings, and cascade company updates and policy changes to Team.

  • Track regional labor costs, overtime, and mileage against budget targets and flag variances to the Supervisor.

    • Performance & Quality Targets

  • Redraw Rate: Maintain low redraw rates across all assigned markets/regions through clinical oversight and quality standards.

  • Critical Error Rate: Minimize critical errors and process deviations across all assigned markets/region.

  • Net Promoter Score (NPS): Drive strong regional patient satisfaction and high Net Promoter Scores.

  • Market Stability: Maintain high operational stability by managing reschedule rates and slot availability targets across the region.

  • Team Lead Effectiveness: Ensure assigned Team Leads maintain full adherence to Leader Standard Work and operational protocols.

  • Team Retention: Support regional phlebotomists and Team retention goals.

What we are looking for:

  • 2+ years of leadership experience (team lead, supervisor, or similar role) in phlebotomy, mobile health, clinical laboratory, or field-based healthcare operations
  • Experience leading other leads or managing teams across multiple sites or markets
  • 5 years of phlebotomy experience is required
  • Phlebotomy certification from an accredited agency is required: American Medical Technologists (AMT), American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP), or National Center for Competency Testing (NCCT)
  • Expert knowledge of phlebotomy techniques, specimen handling, and safety and compliance standards (OSHA, HIPAA)
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and hold leaders accountable
  • Strong analytical skills; comfortable using data and reports to drive decisions
  • Proven track record in providing exceptional customer service
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, including presenting to leadership
  • A disciplined, self-directed leader who can manage multiple markets and priorities
  • Comfortable with digital tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, and scheduling or routing software
  • Reliable transportation, clean driving record, and ability to pass a background check and drug screen
  • Ability to travel up to 40% for market visits, Team Lead development, onboarding, and field training

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Mobile phlebotomy experience
  • Experience with route planning, dispatch, or workforce scheduling for field-based teams
  • Experience approving timecards, payroll, or expenses and managing supply inventory
  • Familiarity with Lean practices or Leader Standard Work

We have great benefits to make your life easier so you can focus on what you're best at:

  • Competitive annual salary ranging $80,000-$95,000

raw.description:
Job Description: Revenue Cycle Manager, Integrated Complex Care Associates

About the role

The Billing Manager is the first full-time hire for Integrated Complex Care Associates (ICC) and owns billing, provider enrollment, and billing compliance for the group. You will review and release every claim ICC sends to Medicare, enroll and support the physicians who join, and be the person physician offices and patients call with billing questions.

ICC is a California physician group serving patients with complex health needs, led by each patient's own primary physician. Physicians across California join ICC while keeping their own practices, and ICC bills Medicare for that work under its own group TIN.

What you'll do

Enroll and onboard physicians

  • Own provider enrollment: each physician's 855I reassignment to ICC, ICC's 855B practice locations, PECOS and NPPES updates, revalidations, and Medicare EFT and remittance setup.
  • Set up each physician's office to submit ICC patients' claims through ICC's payer ID, and confirm the first claims flow end to end.
  • Keep ICC's provider roster current as physicians join or leave, including who each physician is paid through.

Support physicians and their offices

  • Be the main billing contact for each physician's office: answer questions, run short onboarding sessions, and fix submission problems quickly.
  • Walk physicians through their payment reports and how ICC's payments relate to their own practice's billing.

Review and release claims

  • Review every claim before it goes to Medicare. Claims arrive from each physician's own practice system through ICC's payer ID, and ICC's system fills in ICC's TIN, the rendering physician's NPI, and the service location in the Stedi billing portal.
  • Check each claim's CPT/HCPCS codes, modifiers, place of service, units, and diagnosis codes, then approve it, correct it, or send it back to the physician's office.
  • Release approved claims to Medicare (Noridian, Jurisdiction E) under ICC's TIN, and track every claim to payment or denial.

Coding quality

  • Sample claims regularly against the physician's EMR of record (ICC patients only) to confirm the documentation supports what was billed, and track error rates by physician.
  • Use Nightingale's HCC view to spot conditions that may be undocumented. Where the record may support one, send the physician a compliant, non-leading query, and code only what the physician documents.
  • Give physicians and their staff short, specific coding feedback, and escalate patterns to ICC's physician leadership.

Payments and denials

  • Post and reconcile Medicare remittances (835s), work rejections and denials, and file corrections, reopenings, and appeals.
  • Answer physicians' and office staff's questions about specific claims, remittance status, and payment reports.
  • Reconcile what Medicare pays ICC with what ICC pays each physician or physician's practice.

Support patients

  • Call each patient before their first ICC claim goes out to explain how ICC's name will appear on their Medicare statements and whom to call with questions.
  • Answer patients' billing questions and resolve their concerns, working with the physician's office as needed.

Run billing compliance

  • Screen every rendering physician and billing staff member monthly against the OIG exclusion list and SAM.
  • Maintain ICC's billing and coding policies, document audits, and report findings to ICC's physician leadership.
  • Identify, report, and return Medicare overpayments within the federal 60-day rule.
  • Use access to physicians' EMRs only for ICC patients and only as much as each task needs, under HIPAA.

Reporting

You'll be employed by Integrated Complex Care MSO LLC, which provides management services to ICC and handles your employment, pay, and day-to-day administration. For coding, billing, and compliance decisions, you'll work under the direction of ICC's physician leadership (Kaushik Patel, MD) and follow ICC's approved billing and coding policies. Questions about what a physician documented go to that physician, and the final say on how a service is billed rests with ICC.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of Medicare Part B professional billing for physician groups, including claim review, denials, and appeals.
  • Hands-on Medicare provider enrollment: PECOS, 855I reassignments, 855B group enrollment, and revalidations.
  • A current coding credential: CPC or CPB (AAPC) or CCS-P (AHIMA). CRC (risk adjustment) preferred.
  • Working knowledge of ICD-10-CM, CPT/HCPCS, modifiers, and documentation standards for HCC risk adjustment.
  • Claims management experience through a clearinghouse or billing portal: submissions, rejections, and remittances (837P, 277CA, 835).
  • Billing compliance experience: audits, exclusion screening, overpayment refunds, and HIPAA.
  • Familiarity with Medicare ACO programs (MSSP, ACO REACH, or LEAD) a plus.
  • Clear, patient phone and writing skills with physicians, office staff, and older patients; Spanish a plus.
  • Comfort as a first hire: building processes from scratch and working independently.

Location, pay, and logistics

  • Location: remote within California; you must live in California. Pacific time business hours, with occasional travel to physician offices around the state.
  • Pay: $95,000+ base salary, depending on experience and location. Full-time, exempt.
  • Benefits: [Savanna fill in Florence standard benefits]
  • Screening: offers are contingent on a background check after a conditional offer, an OIG and SAM exclusion check, and HIPAA training before system access.
  • Equal opportunity: Integrated Complex Care MSO LLC is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in line with the California Fair Chance Act.

At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:
• Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.
• Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.
• Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.
Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data-driven insights – technology plays an invaluable role in our success. The engineering team at Warner Music Group makes all of it a reality. Check out first-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog!
WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.
Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

The Role

Music is driven by fans, and our data tells their story. We’re looking for a passionate Data Scientist to dive into the massive cultural waves happening across major streaming platforms.

In this role you’ll be translating billions of signals into the heartbeat of our listeners. Using advanced statistical methods and machine learning, you’ll uncover hidden listener behaviors, build predictive models for artist and commercial performance, and forecast what fans want next. You’ll also measure and optimize the impact of our global marketing campaigns, using experimentation and data driven insights to understand what truly drives engagement.

If you’re excited to turn complex data into cultural insight and real world impact, this is the place for you.

What You'll Do

  • Advanced Forecasting & Modeling: Build robust forecasting models across streaming, audience growth, and commercial performance. Support comprehensive forecasting efforts across deal risk, merchandise, and demand planning.

  • Audience Insights & Analytics: Gather and analyze audience data to establish best practices for capturing music listening preferences. Detect anomalies and surface actionable insights from large-scale streaming and engagement data.

  • Hypothesis Testing & Storytelling: Transform complex data into compelling stories via tailor-made presentations. Develop new hypothesis testing frameworks and decision-making tools for the real-time assessment of audience viewing patterns and music delivery streams.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with local affiliates, labels, international teams, and Global Technology. You will also collaborate closely with our merchandising teams and business stakeholders to deliver critical reporting and inference.

  • Data Engineering Integration: Interact directly with data engineering teams to identify, define, and secure the data needs required for your mathematical models.

Who You Are

  • Education: Master's degree (or foreign equivalent) in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, or a highly related quantitative field.

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on DS experience post-BS, or 3+ years of post-Graduate Degree hands-on DS experience

  • Technical Stack: 5+ years of hands-on experience working with R, Python, and SQL.

  • Forecasting: At least 5 years of experience building forecasting models across streaming, audience growth, and commercial performance, including evaluating forecast accuracy and continuously improving performance through testing, backtesting, and iteration.

  • Marketing & Audience Models: At least 5 years of experience using advertising data to build marketing mix models (measuring the incremental impact of ads/campaigns using techniques like multi-linear regression and Hierarchical Bayes).

  • Targeting & Behavior: At least 5 years of experience building targeting models, including propensity scoring and look-alike modeling, to develop actionable insights into audience behavior.

  • Production ML: At least 5 years of experience successfully deploying machine learning models into a production environment.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Proven ability to bridge the gap between technical complexity and business logic, serving as a strategic partner who empowers non-technical teams and leadership to make data-driven decisions.

  • Data Visualization: At least 5 years of experience communicating complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders using data visualizations (e.g., matplotlib, ggplot2, or similar libraries).

As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.
Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.

Role Summary

The Web Application Firewall Engineeris responsible for developing, evaluating and managing systems security across the enterprise. This role will work closely with the application development teams to assess applications in development as well as in production. The Web Application Firewall Engineer will help safeguard applications and data from threats and define and drive the implementation of these capabilities.


Primary Responsibilities - How will you help us Grow!

  • Configure, tune, test, and optimize Web Application Firewall (WAF) policies and rules to protect web applications and APIs from threats such as OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, automated attacks, malicious payloads, and suspicious traffic patterns.
  • Monitor WAF alerts, application traffic, and security events to identify threats, investigate anomalies, reduce false positives, and recommend appropriate remediation actions.
  • Partner with application development, infrastructure, cloud, and network teams to understand application behavior, define security requirements, and implement WAF controls with minimal business disruption.
  • Assists in the development and implementation of security policies and procedures.
  • Instrumental in data security, regulatory compliance, DDoS mitigation, application protection, and threat detection.
  • Prepares status reports on security matters to develop security risk analysis scenarios and response procedures.
  • Enforces security policies and procedures by administering and monitoring security profiles, reviews security violation reports and investigates possible security exceptions, updates, and maintains and documents security controls.
  • Involved in the evaluation of products and/or procedures to enhance productivity and effectiveness.
  • Provides direct support to the business and IT staff for systems security related issues.
  • Participates in on-call to support WAF operations, respond to security events, troubleshoot urgent production issues, and coordinate timely escalation or remediation as needed.

Education and Experience – What you will bring to the table!

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred.
  • 7–10 years of experience with WAF technologies and/or networking.
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise WAF platforms such as Akamai, Cloudflare, F5, Imperva, or Azure/AWS WAF.
  • Deep understanding of OWASP Top 10, API security, bot mitigation, DDoS protection, and web application attack patterns.
  • Experience tuning WAF rules, reducing false positives, and balancing security controls with application availability.
  • Knowledge of HTTP/S, TLS, DNS, CDN, reverse proxy, load balancing, and web application architectures.
  • Experience partnering with application, infrastructure, cloud, and security operations teams to onboard and protect applications.
  • Familiarity with SIEM/SOAR integrations, logging, alerting, incident response, and threat detection workflows.Ability to document standards, operational procedures, exceptions, and risk-based decisions.
  • Preferred certifications could include CISSP, CSSLP, GIAC, AWS/Azure security, or vendor-specific WAF certifications.
  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills and the ability to develop processes and methodologies.
  • Ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies.
  • Ability to prioritize work to meet tight deadlines and customer needs.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with strong oral, written, and presentation skills.

  • Learn more about our total rewards package here - Vylor Benefits

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Aperçu de l’entreprise

Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Nos solutions favorisent la collaboration essentielle pour améliorer la sécurité des populations, des écoles, des hôpitaux, des entreprises et, finalement, des nations. Connectez-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.


Department Overview

D-Fend Solutions, a Motorola Solutions Inc. company, values its employees as our greatest asset. Our professionals and subject matter experts, including personnel from elite military intelligence technology units, provide the best possible solutions to leading customers around the world. We are proud of our impressive presence across different environments and industries, as well as the results we have helped our customers achieve in contending with their counter-drone challenges.

In addition to professional expertise, D-Fend Solutions seeks candidates who thrive in a fast-moving, innovative and collaborative culture. It helps if you enjoy having fun – our “D-Fenders” are a light-hearted bunch who have stashed rubber ducks all around our headquarters.

Are you interested in working with the world’s leading cyber-takeover counter-drone technology provider?

Join D-Fend Solutions in helping to make the world a safer place by addressing emerging challenges in the dynamic and exciting counter-drone arena!


Job Description

The Presales Engineer will assist sales managers in qualifying customer technical requirements, demonstrating the technical and operational features of the D-Fend product line, and answer all questions related to D-Fend's products to the satisfaction of the customers. The Presales Engineer will ensure proper handover of information to the Professional Services Team to prepare them for the client engagement and project implementation by sharing knowledge gained about the customer environment, systems, and risk profile. The Presales Engineer will also carry lessons learned from their activities and present these to the relevant product teams to supply input for the strategic direction of the product line.


Specific Duties & Activities:

  • Product demonstration and presentation. Prepare, present, and demonstrate Company's products to prospective customers
  • Conduct Proof-of Concepts (POCs) and relevance field trials
  • Work and communicate efficiently with the customer, internal teams, and other external interfaces to provide the best product demonstration to the customer
  • Communicate all technical and operational features and benefits of the Company's products to the customer
  • Enable new sales opportunities by constantly collecting information on new customer requirements, changes in the field of c-UAV/counter drones, and potential competitors
  • Other duties assigned by D-Fend's management from time to time

Qualifications:

  • Bachelors Degree is preferred
  • 5+ years of experience in Sales, Engineering or Solutions Architecture
  • Strong written and oral communications skills with the ability to present complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Ability to build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Willingness to think out of the box and challenge the status quo
  • Attention to detail and a flawless execution mindset

25-50%

Meet the Team

Join a dynamic group of technical sales professionals dedicated to representing the Cisco brand and delivering impactful solutions to our customers and partners. As a vital part of the account team, you will collaborate with connected sales units to ensure long-term customer success through strategic planning and innovation. The team functions as a trusted advisor, bridging the gap between complex business needs and Cisco’s diverse technology portfolio to drive market penetration. You will have the unique opportunity to lead virtual support teams and provide direct feedback to Business Entities, helping to shape future market opportunities. This role offers an exciting environment where you can influence strategic priorities and displace competition within the Richmond territory.

Your Impact

Drive growth by pinpointing new opportunities and aligning technical strategies directly with customer business objectives. Lead high-level solution conversations with technical executives to promote cross-architecture designs and drive innovation. Execute demand generation and enablement campaigns to address underlying customer challenges and differentiate Cisco solutions from the competition. Conduct technical demonstrations that illustrate how specific products solve business hurdles to increase revenue and expand market share. Mentor extended sales teams to strengthen collective knowledge and guide structured educational initiatives across the organization.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 7+ years of related experience
  • Experience in technical sales or serving as a technical advisor for enterprise customers and partners
  • Proficiency in Cisco's technology portfolio and cross-architectural solution design.
  • Experience leading the technical sales process from opportunity identification through to closing deals
  • Background in competitive market analysis and displacement strategies within enterprise accounts.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of pre-sales experience
  • Ability to translate complex business needs into clear technical requirements for diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership skills to motivate and guide virtual support and extended sales teams.
  • Experience providing strategic feedback to Business Entities regarding market trends and customer needs.
  • Proven track record of influencing strategic priorities for C-suite and technical executives.
  • Adaptability to evolve strategies in response to shifting market conditions and competitive tactics.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

The starting salary range posted for this position is $202,400.00 to $257,900.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits.

Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.

U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

  • 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees

  • 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco

  • Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees

  • Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)

  • 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next

  • Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members

  • Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

  • .75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;

  • 1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%;

  • 1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

raw.title: Phlebotomist Senior Team Lead
raw.excerpt: Getlabs is the leading platform for at-home diagnostics.
raw.description:
Getlabs is the leading platform for at-home diagnostics.
Healthcare organizations use Getlabs to send mobile phlebotomists to patients’ homes and collect labs, vitals, and advanced diagnostics. By leveraging Getlabs, partners can improve patient adherence and close gaps in care with same-day, nationwide availability.
Our team has raised $50M from strategic investors including the two largest diagnostic laboratories in the United States, Labcorp and Quest. Getlabs’ mission is to save lives by expanding access to diagnostics for everyone.
The Phlebotomist Senior Team Lead oversees operational performance, quality compliance, and leadership development across a multi-market region. Building on the Team Lead foundation, this role leads, coaches, and holds accountable a group of phlebotomists and shift leads, serving as the escalation point above the Team Lead level, if supervisor is unavailable. Operating under Leader Standard Work (LSW), the Senior Team Lead maintains clinical competency with a reduced patient appointment load, shifting focus from daily execution to regional coverage strategy, performance trend analysis, process improvement, and partnership with Operations Management.

THIS IS A REMOTE POSITION!

This position is currently limited to candidates residing within a 20-30 mile radius of San Francisco, CA.

At Getlabs, you will:

    Team Lead Leadership & Development

  • Directly supervise, coach, and develop assigned teams; conduct weekly 1:1s and monthly performance check-ins.

  • Audit Team adherence to Leader Standard Work, the 20/24 Rule, and call-out procedures; provide feedback and corrective coaching as needed.

  • Train and certify new Team on LSW, routing, payroll/triplog audits, and quality assessment standards.

  • Identify high-potential phlebotomists and build a succession pipeline for future Team Lead roles.

    • Regional Operations & Escalation Management

  • Serve as the Tier 2 escalation point for operational, clinical, and patient issues that Team Leads cannot resolve within the 20/24 Rule.

  • Own weekly regional coverage planning, including PRN pool strategy, cross-market staffing, and capacity forecasting for upcoming demand.

  • Review Team route optimization and next-day coverage plans; intervene on high-risk markets to protect availability and reschedule targets.

  • Provide final review and sign-off on Team Payroll, Triplog, timecard, and expense submissions before payroll deadlines.

  • Oversee regional inventory and equipment budgets; analyze supply usage trends and approve purchase orders and new hire equipment requests.

    • Quality, Performance Analysis & Process Improvement

  • Analyze regional quality and performance data (redraws, critical errors, NPS, reschedules) to identify trends and root causes; build and track action plans with Team.

  • Calibrate venipuncture assessments and SOP audits across Team to ensure consistent quality standards across markets.

  • Lead formal corrective action and performance improvement plans in partnership with HR and Operations Management; review Team -issued corrective actions for consistency.

  • Identify process gaps and recommend SOP, training, and workflow improvements; pilot and roll out approved changes across the region.

  • Prepare and present regional performance reports to Operations Management on a weekly and monthly cadence.

    • Hiring, Onboarding & Training Strategy

  • Partner with Recruiting on regional hiring needs; conduct final-round interviews and make hiring recommendations.

  • Own the regional onboarding and training plan, ensuring Team Leads deliver consistent new hire onboarding, ride-alongs, and field training.

  • Develop and deliver advanced clinical and leadership training for Team Leads and senior phlebotomists.

    • Shared Supervisor Duties

  • Serve as acting supervisor during Operations Supervisor PTO, absences, and peak periods, with authority to make same-day staffing, scheduling, and escalation decisions.

  • Approve time-off requests, schedule changes, and overtime for phlebotomists within established guidelines.

  • Co-lead performance reviews for phlebotomists and Shift Leads, providing documented feedback and development goals.

  • Partner with the Supervisor and HR on documenting and delivering written warnings and final corrective actions, in line with company policy.

  • Address employee relations concerns at the first level and escalate to the Supervisor or HR when appropriate.

  • Ensure regional compliance with OSHA, HIPAA, and state phlebotomy regulations; lead incident reporting and follow-up for needlesticks, specimen loss, and patient complaints.

  • Represent the region in supervisor and leadership meetings, and cascade company updates and policy changes to Team.

  • Track regional labor costs, overtime, and mileage against budget targets and flag variances to the Supervisor.

    • Performance & Quality Targets

  • Redraw Rate: Maintain low redraw rates across all assigned markets/regions through clinical oversight and quality standards.

  • Critical Error Rate: Minimize critical errors and process deviations across all assigned markets/region.

  • Net Promoter Score (NPS): Drive strong regional patient satisfaction and high Net Promoter Scores.

  • Market Stability: Maintain high operational stability by managing reschedule rates and slot availability targets across the region.

  • Team Lead Effectiveness: Ensure assigned Team Leads maintain full adherence to Leader Standard Work and operational protocols.

  • Team Retention: Support regional phlebotomists and Team retention goals.

What we are looking for:

  • 2+ years of leadership experience (team lead, supervisor, or similar role) in phlebotomy, mobile health, clinical laboratory, or field-based healthcare operations
  • Experience leading other leads or managing teams across multiple sites or markets
  • 5 years of phlebotomy experience is required
  • Phlebotomy certification from an accredited agency is required: American Medical Technologists (AMT), American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP), or National Center for Competency Testing (NCCT)
  • Expert knowledge of phlebotomy techniques, specimen handling, and safety and compliance standards (OSHA, HIPAA)
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and hold leaders accountable
  • Strong analytical skills; comfortable using data and reports to drive decisions
  • Proven track record in providing exceptional customer service
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, including presenting to leadership
  • A disciplined, self-directed leader who can manage multiple markets and priorities
  • Comfortable with digital tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, and scheduling or routing software
  • Reliable transportation, clean driving record, and ability to pass a background check and drug screen
  • Ability to travel up to 40% for market visits, Team Lead development, onboarding, and field training

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Mobile phlebotomy experience
  • Experience with route planning, dispatch, or workforce scheduling for field-based teams
  • Experience approving timecards, payroll, or expenses and managing supply inventory
  • Familiarity with Lean practices or Leader Standard Work

We have great benefits to make your life easier so you can focus on what you're best at:

  • Competitive annual salary ranging $80,000-$95,000
  • Medical, dental and vision insurance options
  • Flexible vacation
  • A company with a huge vision, a dynamic work environment, and a team of talented, ambitious and fun to work-with colleagues!
The health and safety of our employees and their families is our top priority. Due to the ongoing nature of the COVID-19 pandemic we have decided to require vaccination as a condition of employment for any employee who is in contact with patients.

This role will support a highly strategic portfolio of approximately seven large-scale, household-name retail and consumer brands. The territory includes some of the largest and most complex organizations in their respective segments, spanning global food and beverage, retail, restaurant, and home improvement.

The Senior Solution Sales Executive will drive market success for ServiceNow's Moveworks solutions across these strategic accounts. This is a specialist sales role focused on helping large enterprises transform how employees find information and get work done through enterprise AI, intelligent search, and agentic automation across business systems and workflows.

Moveworks opportunities can span IT, HR, Finance, Procurement, Operations, and other enterprise functions, with buying groups that may include CIOs, CHROs, CFO/Finance leaders, functional executives, IT operations leaders, enterprise architects, and AI/transformation leaders.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Drive the Moveworks sales strategy and execution across a focused portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts.
  • Partner with Account Executives and account teams to identify and develop enterprise AI opportunities across IT, HR, Finance, Procurement, and other business functions.
  • Engage senior executives and business leaders, connecting AI, enterprise search, and automation to measurable business outcomes.
  • Lead consultative discovery, develop compelling use cases, and navigate complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles.
  • Partner with Solution Consultants and technical teams to deliver a differentiated solution strategy and win.
  • Enable account teams to identify Moveworks opportunities and accelerate adoption and expansion.

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Central Time Zone location strongly preferred. Ability to travel 30–50%
  • 7+ years of enterprise software sales experience, selling AI, automation, SaaS, or other transferable solutions (transferable BUs, Personas, solution area)
  • Strong ability to translate AI and technical capabilities into business value and measurable outcomes
  • 5+ years Enterprise (5K+ EE) segment experience with consistent, measurable success metrics
  • Experience engaging C-level and senior business leaders across lines of business and IT
  • Startup exposure or comparable builder mentality, with comfort operating quickly in ambiguity
  • Experience as a specialist seller within a matrixed account team environment preferred
  • Executive presence, consultative selling, and ability to establish credibility externally and internally
