raw.description:
Revinate is the hotel data activation platform for hotels, groups, resorts, and enterprise brands.

Every hotel has that guest: years of stays, the same room, never skips the spa. But their story sits scattered across the PMS, the booking engine, the spa system, and whoever happened to be on shift. Revinate brings that story together. We connect and clean guest data from every system into Rich Guest Profile® data, then put it to work for the people who look after guests.

Reservations answers the phone already knowing the guest. Marketing sends the spa offer to the guest who raved about the spa. Behind it all, Ivy, our AI intelligence layer trained on 17 years of hospitality data, reads the patterns and handles the digital labor.

Revinate powers 1.1 billion Rich Guest Profile® data points across 12,500+ hotels, driving over $24 billion in direct revenue.

Get Revinate. Get superpowers.

About the Role

Hotels and resort groups are under pressure to drive direct bookings and grow guest lifetime value. Revinate helps them do it. As a Senior Sales Executive, you’ll own the full cycle for large, multi-property hospitality accounts: opening doors, building consensus across stakeholders, and closing deals that reshape how our clients engage their guests.

You’ll partner closely with a Sales Engineer and senior leadership, and you’ll be trusted to translate complex business and technology problems into clear, quantified value.

What You’ll Do

  • Win new enterprise logos. Leverage your hospitality network and build new relationships with hotel groups, management companies, and brands. Develop proposals, negotiate contracts, and close.

  • Sell consultatively. Diagnose client objectives, then lead with a point of view and business value case that connects Revinate solutions to measurable outcomes.

  • Build multi-threaded deals. Engage and align stakeholders across revenue, marketing, operations, IT, and the C-suite.

  • Orchestrate your deal team. Know when and how to bring in your Sales Engineer, executives, and internal experts to accelerate and de-risk deals.

  • Grow existing accounts. Identify upsell opportunities by tying Revinate solutions to each client’s evolving goals.

  • Forecast with discipline. Maintain accurate pipeline, forecasts, and deal data in Salesforce, updated in real time, and use Gong to sharpen deal execution.

  • Partner internally. Work with Customer Success, Product, and Operations to deliver a seamless client experience from signature through renewal.

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years of quota-carrying SaaS sales experience, including 5+ years selling to enterprise accounts

  • 2+ years selling hospitality technology

  • Existing relationships with hotel groups, management companies, or brands that you can credibly open doors with

  • Proven experience selling net-new business into hotels, including winning new logos from first contact to close

  • Consistent track record of meeting or exceeding quota

  • Proven success building and growing enterprise accounts in hospitality tech, SaaS, or analytics/big data

  • Experience with value-based selling, including building a point of view and business value assessment

  • Working knowledge of a structured sales methodology (MEDDICC, Challenger, Sandler, or SPIN)

  • Proficiency in Salesforce and Gong

  • Demonstrated rigor in CRM hygiene, account planning, and consistent follow-up

  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex ideas simple

  • Willingness to travel as business needs require

Excited?! Want to learn more? Apply Now!

Our Core Values:

One Revinate - United & Strong, on a single mission together
Built on Trust - It’s the foundation of everything we do
Expect Amazing - We think, dream & deliver big
Customer Love -- When the customer wins, we win
Make it Simpler -- Apply it to everything we do
Hungerness -- Feel it, follow it, be relentless about our success
Grounded in Gratitude - We’re glad to be here & make the most of every day

Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.


The following position is to join our RTX Enterprise Services team:


We are seeking a Software Developer to support the development, enhancement, and deployment of mission-critical applications hosted on the cloud. In this role, you will contribute to the modernization of existing applications, drive new development initiatives, and ensure seamless production deployments. You will work in an Agile environment, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.

What You Will Do

  • Develop, enhance, and maintain cloud-hosted applications to meet business and technical requirements.
  • Implement and manage REST APIs and backend services using Spring Boot and Java.

  • Proficiency in version control systems such as Subversion (SVN) with experience with JWT and YAML for secure data handling and configuration.

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Experience with MAVEN for project management and build automation.
  • Knowledge of SOLR/Lucene for search functionality and indexing.
  • Familiarity with browser security concepts and best practices with experience with Maria DB for database management.
  • Proficiency in JUnit for unit testing with knowledge of Angular for front-end development.
  • Experience with Git and GitHub Actions for version control and CI/CD pipelines.

What We Offer

Whether you’re just starting out on your career journey or are an experienced professional, we offer a robust total rewards package with compensation; healthcare, wellness, retirement and work/life benefits; career development and recognition programs. Some of the benefits we offer include parental (including paternal) leave, flexible work schedules, achievement awards, educational assistance and child/adult backup care.

raw.title: Staff Writer
raw.excerpt: The Brooks McCormick Jr.  Animal Law and Policy Program (ALPP) is seeking a senior professional responsible for shaping and advancing the intellectual, collaborative, and public-facing work of the ALPP.
raw.description:
The Brooks McCormick Jr. Animal Law and Policy Program (ALPP) is seeking a senior professional responsible for shaping and advancing the intellectual, collaborative, and public-facing work of the ALPP. The Staff Writer will lead a portfolio that includes mentoring Visiting Fellows, Research Fellows, and students in relation to their scholarly work; they will build and sustain a dynamic workshop series, provide guidance to Fellows, staff and students based on editorial and publishing expertise, produce reports, newsletters, and internal Program resources, and advance the ALPP’s research agenda and external profile.

The Staff Writer will work independently and collaboratively with the Faculty Director, Executive Director, and Program staff to develop Fellows’ book projects and scholarly trajectories, develop key scholarly and public partnerships, transform academic research into high-impact publications and convenings, and build and strengthen relationships across disciplines within and beyond the Harvard Law School and Harvard University.

As a Staff Writer you will:

  • Manage the ALPP’s interdisciplinary workshop series to foster intellectual exchange and scholarly collaboration, and advance manuscript development by Visiting Fellows and scholars.
  • Produce impactful public-facing Program materials including conference reports, Years in Review, newsletters and web content, and support the production of Op Eds through research and writing.
  • Produce independent, original scholarly work that contributes to the Program’s core intellectual work.
  • Mentor staff, Fellows, and students to conceptualize writing projects from idea to published work and guide the research and writing of research assistants and interns as required.
  • In consultation with and subject to the direction of the Faculty Director and Executive Director, identify and cultivate opportunities for collaborative research projects, edited volumes, and cross-institutional partnerships, and develop and document concepts for initiatives and convenings that align with Program priorities.
  • Support the interdisciplinary research and writing of the Faculty Director.
  • Assist with Program requirements as needed.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree and five or more years of experience in publishing or writing in an academic context or closely related area.

Additional Qualifications and Skills

We are looking for people who have:

  • Master’s degree
  • Strong research, writing, editing and proofreading skills
  • Expertise with, or willingness to learn WordPress or a similar publishing platform
  • Experience in an academic research environment, including planning and facilitating workshops or other convenings that support intellectual exchange
  • Familiarity with scholarly and trade publishing, including experience working with agents, editors, or publishers
  • Strong interpersonal skills and a commitment to teamwork; demonstrated ability to build effective, consultative partnerships across academic and administrative units
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, including using and maintaining shared filing systems and handling confidential and sensitive information
  • Ability to work independently in an environment with multiple priorities

Appointment End Date: This is a one-year term appointment with potential for renewal subject to funding and departmental need.

Standard Hours/Schedule: Full-time. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required.

Visa Sponsorship Information: Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position

Pre-Employment Screening: Identity, Education

Other Information:

Travel may be required for this position as needed, including on-site meetings, conferences, and events.

All offers are made by HLS Human Resources.

Work Format Details

This position has been determined by school or unit leaders that the duties and responsibilities can effectively be performed fully remotely at a non-Harvard location. Employees in fully remote positions must work all scheduled hours in a Harvard registered state in compliance with the University’s Policy on Employment Outside of Massachusetts. At the discretion of the department, fully remote employees may occasionally be required on site at a Harvard location. Certain visa types and funding sources may limit work location. Individuals must meet work location sponsorship requirements prior to employment.

Salary Grade and Ranges

This position is salary grade level 057. Please visit  Harvard's Salary Ranges  to view the corresponding salary range and related information.

Benefits

Harvard offers a comprehensive benefits package that is designed to support a healthy work-life balance and your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. Because here, you are what matters. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Generous paid time off including parental leave
  • Medical, dental, and vision health insurance coverage starting on day one
  • Retirement plans with university contributions
  • Wellbeing and mental health resources
  • Support for families and caregivers
  • Professional development opportunities including tuition assistance and reimbursement
  • Commuter benefits, discounts and campus perks

Learn more about these and additional benefits on our Benefits & Wellbeing Page.

EEO/Non-Discrimination Commitment Statement

Harvard University is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination. We seek talent from all parts of society and the world, and we strive to ensure everyone at Harvard thrives. Our differences help our community advance Harvard's academic purposes.

Harvard has an equal employment opportunity policy that outlines our commitment to prohibiting discrimination on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, religion, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law or identified in the university's non-discrimination policy. Harvard's equal employment opportunity policy and non-discrimination policy help all community members participate fully in work and campus life free from harassment and discrimination.

By working at Harvard University, you join a vibrant community that advances Harvard's world-changing mission in meaningful ways, inspires innovation and collaboration, and builds skills and expertise. We are dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming environment where everyone can thrive.

Why join Harvard Law School?

Join a community that combines excellence in legal education and scholarship with a deep commitment to justice. Here at Harvard Law School (HLS), you’ll find an environment that values who you are and encourages you to grow, inspire others, and make a meaningful impact. Wherever you are in your career journey, HLS is a place where you can thrive, contribute, and be part of something bigger.

raw.description:
Business Unit Operations Leader

Job Duties and Responsibilities

The Business Unit Operations Leader (“Ops Leader”) is responsible for directing and delivering on product and service quality requirement of our Clients. S/he provides strategic direction to the Facility/Site Leaders for the business. The Ops Leader should be adept at developing tactical action plans based on the ability to assess current and future market opportunities, identify client trends, evaluate cu1rrent capabilities and achieve defined financial targets. General duties fall under these four categories:

Senior Leadership Duties:

  • Establish clear expectations for the organization that following RRD’s policies and Principles of Ethical Business Conduct. A clear “tone from the top” is expected from every leader in the Company
  • Participate in the development and implementation of a comprehensive strategic plan
  • Set clear operational equipment performance standards and operating cost objectives
  • Collaborate with the Business Unit Leadership Team to develop and implement effective solutions to business challenges
  • Drive the Business Unit to achieve and surpass sales and profitability goals
  • Collaborate in the development, communication and implementation of effective growth strategies and processes
  • Understand Client needs and develop effective strategies to improve upon existing capabilities/solutions and develop new capabilities/solutions
  • Monitor competitor/market activity to recommend additional opportunities for RRD
  • Understand initiatives driven by functional process leaders (e.g. Finance, HR, IT, Legal) and collaborate to bring business perspective and support the overall approach
  • Perform other related duties and participate in special projects as assigned
  • Develop internal talent and recruit new people to the organization
  • Display leadership skills that provide a vision and direction people follow
  • Develop a culture of excellence, accountability, and compliance

Manufacturing Leadership Duties:

  • Work with Facility Leaders and Corporate EHS staff to build an organization that ensures the work environment is safe for all employees
  • Ensure we have the proper equipment and people efficiency measurement systems in place
  • Identify operational failures and work with Facility Leaders to put in place corrective actions
  • Establish standard Business processes across the delivery platform
  • Establish operational measurement definitions and the tools to measure the equipment efficiency
  • Establish regular review meetings with Facility Operations Leaders to review productivity results
  • Work with Business Unit President to establish standards for on-time delivery and turn-times
  • Develop “Best in Class” metrics for facility indirect and functional costs to determine the most efficient approaches at the facilities within the platform. By identifying best practices, they can be replicated and shared between facilities in the platform to drive improvement
  • Work with the Information Technology group (“IT”) to ensure we have the tools to support the execution of key business processes
  • Possess policy & process discipline with continuous improvement:
    • Support and guide facilities and their plant leadership in the maximization of operating efficiency and productivity
    • Ensure operations systems, procedures and policies are deployed effectively and are consistently applied at all operating locations. Oversee and hold plant leadership accountable for leading and developing strategies for continuous improvement, space/equipment utilization and effective labor management
    • Oversee and hold plant leadership accountable for establishing clear goals/objectives to enhance quality assurance, product safety, continuous improvement and client satisfaction
    • Work with EHS Corporate Leads to ensure Company policy, training, and other miscellaneous requirements are met personally, and at each of their assigned facilities
  • Jointly establish project capital prioritization
  • Ensure alignment between Client needs and our internal operational capabilities
  • Work with Human Resources (“HR”) to standardize job descriptions across the platform and ensure we have proper pay scales to attract and retain employees
  • Work with Business Unit President to determine optimal number of sites in the Platform to deliver for our Clients
  • Work with the BU President and Procurement Leader to develop procurement strategies for major “material” components and key equipment suppliers

Sales Leadership Duties:

  • Establish relationships with key Clients of the Business as needed
  • Understand the key Industry Segments that make up the Clients within the Business and the relevant solutions
  • Understand the Client Pricing profiles and provide input into acceptable pricing levels for the Business
  • Work with Sales Management to understand the Business value proposition and its impact on the operational platform
  • Work with the Sales Leader to understand the strategies to retain existing Clients and minimize “churn”
  • Collaborate with other RRD businesses to understand companion offerings
  • Work with Legal to understand key “terms & conditions” that are boundaries for agreements to ensure we have the ability to deliver on these commitments

Finance Leadership Duties:

  • Manage the P&L to meet financial objectives set forth in the budget and forecast
  • Understand cost drivers of the business and identify areas of good performance and areas that need attention
  • Establish monthly review meetings with Facility Leaders to review the Detailed Income Statement
  • Analyze the SGA cost of the Business and determine methods to build the most efficient indirect cost structure to serve Client needs while minimizing expense to RRD
  • Work with the Finance Leader to identify cost problem areas
  • Be part of the Annual Operating Plan/Budget and forecasting process to determine revenue and margin projections

Scheduling/Planning Optimization Leadership Duties

  • Provide the data to the Optimization Leader to monitor the loading and planning of key equipment and people assets of the business
  • Collaborate to set objectives and KPIs to monitor capacity management and utilization
  • Provide input to determine the optimal mix of work types that will yield the highest total profit dollars
  • Ensure job cost data is collected accurately as the input to the cost rates that are reflected in our Pricing Systems
  • Provide input into the Pricing Strategy based on optimizing equipment and people utilization

Job Knowledge & Skills

This role requires a broad base of skills. Characteristics of successful leaders in this position include:

  • Bachelor's degree in printing, engineering, business, or related area required. Master's degree is preferred
  • 15+ years of print operations experience in a manufacturing or production-based environment
  • 8+ years of demonstrated leadership and vision in managing staff, groups and major projects or initiatives
  • Demonstrated personal and professional character, integrity, work ethic, and drive for company success
  • Understanding of Lean Manufacturing and Statistical Process Control to drive operational improvement
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and a collaborative management style
  • Deep understanding of accounting, reporting and annual budgeting
  • Excel at operating in a fast paced, community environment
  • High sense of urgency
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, along with the ability to listen for understanding
  • Proven experience overseeing and guiding the management of staffing, budgets and other fiscal operations impacting the P financial acumen – can assess revenue and cost drivers of a business
  • Consistent achievement of revenue and margin goals for area of accountability
  • Demonstrated success in strategic thinking and execution
  • Creative problem solving and analytical mindset
  • Experience in developing strategic plans
  • Goal orientation focused on business performance and success metrics
  • Ability to implement significant change and be effective in a short period of time, pushing the organization for ongoing change at a strong pace
  • Collaborative team player – strong consensus building and influencing skills
  • Leadership through doing and inspiring others; is a passionate leader of people – a people builder
  • Exceptional verbal and writing communications skills
  • Committed to continuous improvement in own abilities and those of others
  • Strong belief in the value of a diverse and inclusive workforce
  • Unwavering commitment to compliance

Willingness to travel (approximately 50%)

The salary range for this role at the noted RRD location is $208,500.00 - $333,700.00 / annually. Starting pay decisions are determined based on multiple factors including but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, skills, experience, certifications, proficiency, performance, shift, location, and other business needs. Typically, roles follow step progressions to a target rate or set increments over time. Depending on the role, in addition to the hourly rate of pay, the total compensation package may also include overtime, shift differential, call-in, and/or stand-by pay. RRD’s benefit offerings include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, life insurance and other voluntary supplemental insurance coverages, plus parental leave, adoption assistance, tuition assistance and employer/partner discounts.

At RRD, we value innovation, authenticity, and integrity. To uphold the security and fairness of our hiring process, we ask that candidates refrain from using AI tools during interviews to ensure an authentic and secure experience. We appreciate your cooperation as we work to maintain a transparent and equitable hiring process.

All employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of both a pre-employment background and drug screen.

RRD is a leading global provider of marketing, packaging, print, and supply chain solutions that elevate engagement across the complete customer journey. raw.description:
Primary Care Physician
Part-Time | 100% Remote | Connecticut

The MedServ Group is seeking a licensed Primary Care Physician for a part-time, fully remote consulting and clinical leadership opportunity as the company develops primary care services in Connecticut. The physician will work with executive leadership to support the planning and compliant development of a professional entity and potential primary care nurse practitioner services, subject to applicable state law and legal review.

Position Details
• Position: Primary Care Physician
• Employment Type: Part-Time / Consulting
• Schedule: Flexible, part-time; scope and expected hours to be agreed upon
• Location: 100% Remote
• Required Licensure: Active, unrestricted physician license in Connecticut, with qualifications to serve in the applicable professional entity and clinical leadership role under state law
• Compensation: $1,500–$2,500 per month, depending on experience, qualifications, and agreed scope
• Reports To: Executive Leadership

Key Responsibilities
• Work with the CEO and executive leadership on research, planning, and development of primary care services in Connecticut.
• Provide physician-level clinical expertise to support the design of primary care service models, workflows, and quality expectations.
• Advise on clinical governance, patient-care standards, documentation, and appropriate physician oversight of advanced practice providers, as applicable under state law.
• Participate in discussions with leadership and professional advisors regarding the structure and compliant operation of the applicable professional entity.
• Stay informed about developments in primary care, telehealth, professional entity requirements, and healthcare regulations.

Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate is an experienced primary care physician interested in a part-time, remote advisory and clinical leadership role supporting the compliant development of healthcare services.

Education & Credentials
• MD or DO from an accredited medical school.
• Active, unrestricted physician license in Connecticut.
• Board certification or board eligibility in Family Medicine or Internal Medicine preferred.

The Business Intelligence Lead is responsible for leading data and analytics efforts in support of the VA Contact Center, with a focus on transforming data from CRM, telephony, quality management, workforce management, and related operational systems into actionable business intelligence. This role oversees the tools, technologies, applications, and practices used to collect, integrate, analyze, interpret, and present data to drive informed decision-making, improve operational performance, and support strategic outcomes across the contact center environment.

This position partners closely with VA Contact Center leadership, Enrollment leadership, Operations, and IT to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and performance improvement actions based on data analysis. The Business Intelligence Lead is expected to provide insight into key contact center performance drivers such as call volume, average speed of answer, service level, abandonment, first contact resolution, quality, productivity, member experience, and other operational and outcome-based measures. This role synthesizes large and complex data sets into clear recommendations and delivers analysis that enables leadership to make timely, data-driven decisions on matters of significance.

The Business Intelligence Lead also collaborates with business and technical partners to identify, evaluate, and advance AI, automation, and robotic process automation (RPA) opportunities that improve contact center efficiency, effectiveness, and user experience. This includes supporting initiatives from opportunity assessment and business case development through implementation, adoption, and post-deployment benefit validation.

In addition, this role serves as a strategic advisor to operational leadership by developing and informing contact center functional strategies that align with broader enterprise objectives. The individual uses advanced analytical methods, business acumen, and operational knowledge to assess variable factors, identify root causes, forecast impacts, and recommend the best course of action. The role frequently advises leadership on high-impact issues where data analysis is essential to decision-making, including workforce planning, service performance, process improvement, technology optimization, and operational readiness.

The Business Intelligence Lead exercises independent judgment and decision-making on complex assignments and works under minimal supervision. This role is expected to lead through influence, communicate findings effectively to technical and non-technical audiences, and ensure that decisions are grounded in accurate, meaningful, and actionable data.

This is a remote position.

REMOTE / WORK FROM HOME POSITION
Before applying, please note:
The entire application process must be completed in English. Fluent written and spoken English is required and will be evaluated.
Applicants must be independent freelancers, not represented by another agency, and currently based outside the United States.
WHO ARE WE? FOUNTAIN FORWARD
We are a hyper-motivated crew of internet marketing experts based in Houston, Texas. We're on a mission to provide truly profitable data-driven marketing solutions, primarily for The Automotive industry.
We love working together to accomplish one thing: persuade people to do business with our clients, and do it more often. Seeing our clients make more money and collaborating together to accomplish their goals is what drives us to slam down a couple of espressos every morning and fire up our brain cells.
Job Overview / Purpose Statement
The Full Stack Developer builds, improves, and maintains web applications, platforms, and tools that power Fountain Forward’s services. This role works across front-end and back-end technologies, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with business requirements. Developers collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver integrations, automation, and performance improvements.
Responsibilities & Duties
Core Development:
  • Build and maintain full-stack applications using modern frameworks (Next.js and FastAPI).
  • Write clean, efficient Python scripts for automation, integration, or data handling.
  • Develop and document RESTful APIs for internal and external integrations.
  • Design and manage relational databases (PostgreSQL).
Integration & Tooling:
  • Integrate with third-party tools and services (Slack, Google Drive, ClickUp, CRMs).
  • Implement integrations with external APIs and services.
  • Build internal tools that support scalability and workflow efficiency.
Performance, Quality & Maintenance:
  • Optimize application performance, security, and scalability.
  • Debug, test, and maintain code to ensure reliability and stability.
  • Troubleshoot, upgrade, and improve existing software.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  • Work with stakeholders to translate needs into technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with analysts, operations, and sales teams to ensure systems align with business goals.
Innovation & Continuous Improvement:
  • Develop functional applications with modern JavaScript frameworks (Next.js).
  • Stay updated with emerging technologies and best practices; recommend improvements.
  • The team member must be present and actively participate in all FF training sessions they are invited to attend. If unable to attend, they are responsible for reviewing the training materials and catching up on any missed training.

Requirements

Required Skills & Qualifications
Responsibilities & Duties:
1+ years in full-stack development roles.
Strong proficiency with Next.js, and backend best practices with FastAPI.

Quality Control & Oversight:
Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Ability to debug, troubleshoot, and optimize applications.

Analytics & Reporting:
Proficiency with Python for automation and backend scripting.
Ability to integrate and report on system performance.

Process & Project Management:
Experience in API integration, database design (Supabase / PostgreSQL), and cloud deployment (GCP and Railway).

Mentorship & Training:
Excellent communication skills in English; ability to share technical knowledge clearly.

Collaboration:
Strong teamwork with stakeholders and cross-department peers to align technical work with business objectives.
Preferred Experience & Competencies
Must be proficient in English (written and verbal)
Strong problem-solving, quantitative, and analytical abilities.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and delegation skills.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
Knowledge of AI/ML integration basics.
Ability to work independently and align with a remote team in CST hours
OUR HIRING PROCESS
1. Application Review
2. Initial Interview
3. Skills Assessment
4. Final Interview

Benefits

How We Work
  • Freedom and flexibility. We’re a team working from around the world. That is, as long as they show up on our weekly calls, do their job correctly, and have a good sense of accountability.
  • Autonomy and ownership. Working on a distributed team means you don’t have someone micromanaging you or looking over your shoulder to make sure you’re getting things done. We’re a team of do-ers who take full ownership for their results.
  • Be helpful and dedicated. We help our clients be successful. We help our prospects get the right information and make the right decision whether or not it includes our services. We help our team members reach their full potential.
The Perks!
  • Remote-First Culture: Work from home—or anywhere in the world. We value results, not where you log in from.
  • Flexible Schedule: We offer flexibility in your daily schedule (within reason) to help you do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off: Enjoy an unlimited vacation policy with just two weeks’ notice and manager approval. We also offer paid sick days because your well-being matters.
  • Parental Leave: We understand the importance of supporting our team members during significant life events. Our maternity and paternity leave policy ensures you can prioritize your growing family without added stress.
  • Room to Grow: We’re a fast-growing company with massive opportunities for upward mobility. As we grow, you grow with us.
  • Professional Development: Get access to training in digital marketing, advertising, and leadership to sharpen your skills and advance your career.
  • Quarterly Performance Bonuses: Earn bonuses based on your performance and contributions to the company’s success.
  • Paid Referral Program: Earn rewards for referring great talent to join our team!
  • Health & Fitness Reimbursement (upon tenure): Get support for health insurance or a gym membership—because your well-being matters.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Staff Pharmacist interprets physicians’ prescriptions, contacts doctors or other prescribers and/or patients to verify information on prescriptions and expedite processing of order. The Staff Pharmacist may track order status and outstanding issues as well as consult with patients regarding the use of medications and potential drug interactions. This individual may take calls from customers regarding lost orders or dispensing errors, maintain daily production, quality and service levels, vary work priorities and activities to accommodate business needs. The Staff Pharmacist may also train less experienced pharmacists.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Consult with patients regarding the use of medications and potential drug interactions. Contact physicians for new and/or transfer authorization. Collaborate with physicians to convert prescriptions to generic or preferred drugs whenever possible. Interpret physicians’ or prescribers’ prescriptions. Contact doctors and/or patients to verify information on prescriptions such as drug strength, prescription sig., and drug name in order to expedite processing of orders. Provide oversight and quality assurance to pharmacy technicians. Verify and confirm validity of controlled substances. Verify prescription information entered in the system by data entry or order entry. Back up other pharmacists as needed, perform additional duties as assigned by management, or train less experienced pharmacists.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy required, PharmD preferred
  • Current active resident pharmacist license in good standing.
  • Advanced problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with other departments to resolve issues.
  • Good oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to read and interpret prescriptions.
  • Strong focus on customer service, quality and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage timelines and meet tight client deadlines.
  • Ability to adapt in a changing environment.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule for peak volume times.

raw.description:
Job Description: Revenue Cycle Manager, Integrated Complex Care Associates

About the role

The Billing Manager is the first full-time hire for Integrated Complex Care Associates (ICC) and owns billing, provider enrollment, and billing compliance for the group. You will review and release every claim ICC sends to Medicare, enroll and support the physicians who join, and be the person physician offices and patients call with billing questions.

ICC is a California physician group serving patients with complex health needs, led by each patient's own primary physician. Physicians across California join ICC while keeping their own practices, and ICC bills Medicare for that work under its own group TIN.

What you'll do

Enroll and onboard physicians

  • Own provider enrollment: each physician's 855I reassignment to ICC, ICC's 855B practice locations, PECOS and NPPES updates, revalidations, and Medicare EFT and remittance setup.
  • Set up each physician's office to submit ICC patients' claims through ICC's payer ID, and confirm the first claims flow end to end.
  • Keep ICC's provider roster current as physicians join or leave, including who each physician is paid through.

Support physicians and their offices

  • Be the main billing contact for each physician's office: answer questions, run short onboarding sessions, and fix submission problems quickly.
  • Walk physicians through their payment reports and how ICC's payments relate to their own practice's billing.

Review and release claims

  • Review every claim before it goes to Medicare. Claims arrive from each physician's own practice system through ICC's payer ID, and ICC's system fills in ICC's TIN, the rendering physician's NPI, and the service location in the Stedi billing portal.
  • Check each claim's CPT/HCPCS codes, modifiers, place of service, units, and diagnosis codes, then approve it, correct it, or send it back to the physician's office.
  • Release approved claims to Medicare (Noridian, Jurisdiction E) under ICC's TIN, and track every claim to payment or denial.

Coding quality

  • Sample claims regularly against the physician's EMR of record (ICC patients only) to confirm the documentation supports what was billed, and track error rates by physician.
  • Use Nightingale's HCC view to spot conditions that may be undocumented. Where the record may support one, send the physician a compliant, non-leading query, and code only what the physician documents.
  • Give physicians and their staff short, specific coding feedback, and escalate patterns to ICC's physician leadership.

Payments and denials

  • Post and reconcile Medicare remittances (835s), work rejections and denials, and file corrections, reopenings, and appeals.
  • Answer physicians' and office staff's questions about specific claims, remittance status, and payment reports.
  • Reconcile what Medicare pays ICC with what ICC pays each physician or physician's practice.

Support patients

  • Call each patient before their first ICC claim goes out to explain how ICC's name will appear on their Medicare statements and whom to call with questions.
  • Answer patients' billing questions and resolve their concerns, working with the physician's office as needed.

Run billing compliance

  • Screen every rendering physician and billing staff member monthly against the OIG exclusion list and SAM.
  • Maintain ICC's billing and coding policies, document audits, and report findings to ICC's physician leadership.
  • Identify, report, and return Medicare overpayments within the federal 60-day rule.
  • Use access to physicians' EMRs only for ICC patients and only as much as each task needs, under HIPAA.

Reporting

You'll be employed by Integrated Complex Care MSO LLC, which provides management services to ICC and handles your employment, pay, and day-to-day administration. For coding, billing, and compliance decisions, you'll work under the direction of ICC's physician leadership (Kaushik Patel, MD) and follow ICC's approved billing and coding policies. Questions about what a physician documented go to that physician, and the final say on how a service is billed rests with ICC.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of Medicare Part B professional billing for physician groups, including claim review, denials, and appeals.
  • Hands-on Medicare provider enrollment: PECOS, 855I reassignments, 855B group enrollment, and revalidations.
  • A current coding credential: CPC or CPB (AAPC) or CCS-P (AHIMA). CRC (risk adjustment) preferred.
  • Working knowledge of ICD-10-CM, CPT/HCPCS, modifiers, and documentation standards for HCC risk adjustment.
  • Claims management experience through a clearinghouse or billing portal: submissions, rejections, and remittances (837P, 277CA, 835).
  • Billing compliance experience: audits, exclusion screening, overpayment refunds, and HIPAA.
  • Familiarity with Medicare ACO programs (MSSP, ACO REACH, or LEAD) a plus.
  • Clear, patient phone and writing skills with physicians, office staff, and older patients; Spanish a plus.
  • Comfort as a first hire: building processes from scratch and working independently.

Location, pay, and logistics

  • Location: remote within California; you must live in California. Pacific time business hours, with occasional travel to physician offices around the state.
  • Pay: $95,000+ base salary, depending on experience and location. Full-time, exempt.
  • Benefits: [Savanna fill in Florence standard benefits]
  • Screening: offers are contingent on a background check after a conditional offer, an OIG and SAM exclusion check, and HIPAA training before system access.
  • Equal opportunity: Integrated Complex Care MSO LLC is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in line with the California Fair Chance Act.

At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:
• Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.
• Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.
• Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.
Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data-driven insights – technology plays an invaluable role in our success. The engineering team at Warner Music Group makes all of it a reality. Check out first-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog!
WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.
Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

The Role

Music is driven by fans, and our data tells their story. We’re looking for a passionate Data Scientist to dive into the massive cultural waves happening across major streaming platforms.

In this role you’ll be translating billions of signals into the heartbeat of our listeners. Using advanced statistical methods and machine learning, you’ll uncover hidden listener behaviors, build predictive models for artist and commercial performance, and forecast what fans want next. You’ll also measure and optimize the impact of our global marketing campaigns, using experimentation and data driven insights to understand what truly drives engagement.

If you’re excited to turn complex data into cultural insight and real world impact, this is the place for you.

What You'll Do

  • Advanced Forecasting & Modeling: Build robust forecasting models across streaming, audience growth, and commercial performance. Support comprehensive forecasting efforts across deal risk, merchandise, and demand planning.

  • Audience Insights & Analytics: Gather and analyze audience data to establish best practices for capturing music listening preferences. Detect anomalies and surface actionable insights from large-scale streaming and engagement data.

  • Hypothesis Testing & Storytelling: Transform complex data into compelling stories via tailor-made presentations. Develop new hypothesis testing frameworks and decision-making tools for the real-time assessment of audience viewing patterns and music delivery streams.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with local affiliates, labels, international teams, and Global Technology. You will also collaborate closely with our merchandising teams and business stakeholders to deliver critical reporting and inference.

  • Data Engineering Integration: Interact directly with data engineering teams to identify, define, and secure the data needs required for your mathematical models.

Who You Are

  • Education: Master's degree (or foreign equivalent) in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, or a highly related quantitative field.

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on DS experience post-BS, or 3+ years of post-Graduate Degree hands-on DS experience

  • Technical Stack: 5+ years of hands-on experience working with R, Python, and SQL.

  • Forecasting: At least 5 years of experience building forecasting models across streaming, audience growth, and commercial performance, including evaluating forecast accuracy and continuously improving performance through testing, backtesting, and iteration.

  • Marketing & Audience Models: At least 5 years of experience using advertising data to build marketing mix models (measuring the incremental impact of ads/campaigns using techniques like multi-linear regression and Hierarchical Bayes).

  • Targeting & Behavior: At least 5 years of experience building targeting models, including propensity scoring and look-alike modeling, to develop actionable insights into audience behavior.

  • Production ML: At least 5 years of experience successfully deploying machine learning models into a production environment.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Proven ability to bridge the gap between technical complexity and business logic, serving as a strategic partner who empowers non-technical teams and leadership to make data-driven decisions.

  • Data Visualization: At least 5 years of experience communicating complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders using data visualizations (e.g., matplotlib, ggplot2, or similar libraries).

As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

raw.description:
Join Vylor—Powering the Future of Agriculture​

At Vylor, we’re advancing agriculture through breakthrough science—combining elite germplasm, cutting-edge biotech, and next-generation expertise in gene editing and molecular breeding. Our portfolio includes trusted industry brands like Pioneer®, Brevant®, and Hoegemeyer®, delivering performance farmers rely on.​

Join us to help scale innovation globally and shape what’s next in crop science.

Who are we and what do we do?

Vyloris a global leader in advanced seed and genetics. For more than a century, we've advanced scientific discovery and breakthrough innovation to help farmers feed and fuel the world. Our business is backed by next-generation scientific expertise and multiple, distinct routes to market, like our industry-leading seed brands and our licensing business.


The Vylor innovation engine is anchored in the agriculture industry’s most elite germplasm and transformative biotech. The company will leverage its next generation scientific expertise in disciplines like gene editing and molecular breeding to further strengthen its core business while exploring opportunities to expand to new row crops – and potentially beyond. Vylor will scale these innovations using its leading routes-to-market and by significantly expanding its licensing business.


Role Summary

The Web Application Firewall Engineeris responsible for developing, evaluating and managing systems security across the enterprise. This role will work closely with the application development teams to assess applications in development as well as in production. The Web Application Firewall Engineer will help safeguard applications and data from threats and define and drive the implementation of these capabilities.


Primary Responsibilities - How will you help us Grow!

  • Configure, tune, test, and optimize Web Application Firewall (WAF) policies and rules to protect web applications and APIs from threats such as OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, automated attacks, malicious payloads, and suspicious traffic patterns.
  • Monitor WAF alerts, application traffic, and security events to identify threats, investigate anomalies, reduce false positives, and recommend appropriate remediation actions.
  • Partner with application development, infrastructure, cloud, and network teams to understand application behavior, define security requirements, and implement WAF controls with minimal business disruption.
  • Assists in the development and implementation of security policies and procedures.
  • Instrumental in data security, regulatory compliance, DDoS mitigation, application protection, and threat detection.
  • Prepares status reports on security matters to develop security risk analysis scenarios and response procedures.
  • Enforces security policies and procedures by administering and monitoring security profiles, reviews security violation reports and investigates possible security exceptions, updates, and maintains and documents security controls.
  • Involved in the evaluation of products and/or procedures to enhance productivity and effectiveness.
  • Provides direct support to the business and IT staff for systems security related issues.
  • Participates in on-call to support WAF operations, respond to security events, troubleshoot urgent production issues, and coordinate timely escalation or remediation as needed.

Education and Experience – What you will bring to the table!

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred.
  • 7–10 years of experience with WAF technologies and/or networking.
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise WAF platforms such as Akamai, Cloudflare, F5, Imperva, or Azure/AWS WAF.
  • Deep understanding of OWASP Top 10, API security, bot mitigation, DDoS protection, and web application attack patterns.
  • Experience tuning WAF rules, reducing false positives, and balancing security controls with application availability.
  • Knowledge of HTTP/S, TLS, DNS, CDN, reverse proxy, load balancing, and web application architectures.
  • Experience partnering with application, infrastructure, cloud, and security operations teams to onboard and protect applications.
  • Familiarity with SIEM/SOAR integrations, logging, alerting, incident response, and threat detection workflows.Ability to document standards, operational procedures, exceptions, and risk-based decisions.
  • Preferred certifications could include CISSP, CSSLP, GIAC, AWS/Azure security, or vendor-specific WAF certifications.
  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills and the ability to develop processes and methodologies.
  • Ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies.
  • Ability to prioritize work to meet tight deadlines and customer needs.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with strong oral, written, and presentation skills.

Benefits – How We’ll Support You:

  • Numerous development opportunities offered to build your skills
  • Be part of a company with a higher purpose and contribute to making the world a better place
  • Health benefits for you and your family on your first day of employment
  • Four weeks of paid time off and two weeks of well-being pay per year, plus paid holidays
  • Excellent parental leave which includes a minimum of 16 weeks for mother and father
  • Future planning with our competitive retirement savings plan and tuition reimbursement program
  • Learn more about our total rewards package here - Vylor Benefits
  • Check out life at Vylor!

Are you a good match? Apply today! We seek applicants from all backgrounds to ensure we get the best, most creative talent on our team.



Vylor is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing our differences to enrich lives, advance innovation, and boost company performance. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, military or veteran status, pregnancy related conditions (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), disability or any other protected status in accordance with federal, state, or local laws.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Aperçu de l’entreprise

Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Nos solutions favorisent la collaboration essentielle pour améliorer la sécurité des populations, des écoles, des hôpitaux, des entreprises et, finalement, des nations. Connectez-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.


Department Overview

D-Fend Solutions, a Motorola Solutions Inc. company, values its employees as our greatest asset. Our professionals and subject matter experts, including personnel from elite military intelligence technology units, provide the best possible solutions to leading customers around the world. We are proud of our impressive presence across different environments and industries, as well as the results we have helped our customers achieve in contending with their counter-drone challenges.

In addition to professional expertise, D-Fend Solutions seeks candidates who thrive in a fast-moving, innovative and collaborative culture. It helps if you enjoy having fun – our “D-Fenders” are a light-hearted bunch who have stashed rubber ducks all around our headquarters.

Are you interested in working with the world’s leading cyber-takeover counter-drone technology provider?

Join D-Fend Solutions in helping to make the world a safer place by addressing emerging challenges in the dynamic and exciting counter-drone arena!


Job Description

The Presales Engineer will assist sales managers in qualifying customer technical requirements, demonstrating the technical and operational features of the D-Fend product line, and answer all questions related to D-Fend's products to the satisfaction of the customers. The Presales Engineer will ensure proper handover of information to the Professional Services Team to prepare them for the client engagement and project implementation by sharing knowledge gained about the customer environment, systems, and risk profile. The Presales Engineer will also carry lessons learned from their activities and present these to the relevant product teams to supply input for the strategic direction of the product line.


Specific Duties & Activities:

  • Product demonstration and presentation. Prepare, present, and demonstrate Company's products to prospective customers
  • Conduct Proof-of Concepts (POCs) and relevance field trials
  • Work and communicate efficiently with the customer, internal teams, and other external interfaces to provide the best product demonstration to the customer
  • Communicate all technical and operational features and benefits of the Company's products to the customer
  • Enable new sales opportunities by constantly collecting information on new customer requirements, changes in the field of c-UAV/counter drones, and potential competitors
  • Other duties assigned by D-Fend's management from time to time

Qualifications:

  • Bachelors Degree is preferred
  • 5+ years of experience in Sales, Engineering or Solutions Architecture
  • Strong written and oral communications skills with the ability to present complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Ability to build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Willingness to think out of the box and challenge the status quo
  • Attention to detail and a flawless execution mindset



Basic Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Sales, Engineering or Solutions Architecture


Travel Requirements

25-50%


Relocation Provided

None


Position Type

Experienced


Referral Payment Plan

No

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience for candidates with disabilities, or other physical or mental health conditions. To request an accommodation, please complete this Reasonable Accommodations Form so we can assist you.

Motorola Solutions adopte, favorise et promeut les principes de diversité, d’équité et d’inclusion. Nous encourageons et accueillons les candidatures de toutes les personnes qualifiées, quelles que soient leur race, origines ethnique, religion ou croyance, orientation sexuelle, identité et expression sexuelle, statut d’anciens combattants ou tout autre statut protégé par la Loi.

Nous sommes fiers de notre culture axée sur les personnes et les communautés, encourageant ainsi chaque Motorolan d’être la version la plus authentique de lui-même dans ses responsabilités afin de tenir la promesse d’un monde plus sécuritaire.

Meet the Team

Join a dynamic group of technical sales professionals dedicated to representing the Cisco brand and delivering impactful solutions to our customers and partners. As a vital part of the account team, you will collaborate with connected sales units to ensure long-term customer success through strategic planning and innovation. The team functions as a trusted advisor, bridging the gap between complex business needs and Cisco’s diverse technology portfolio to drive market penetration. You will have the unique opportunity to lead virtual support teams and provide direct feedback to Business Entities, helping to shape future market opportunities. This role offers an exciting environment where you can influence strategic priorities and displace competition within the Richmond territory.

Your Impact

Drive growth by pinpointing new opportunities and aligning technical strategies directly with customer business objectives. Lead high-level solution conversations with technical executives to promote cross-architecture designs and drive innovation. Execute demand generation and enablement campaigns to address underlying customer challenges and differentiate Cisco solutions from the competition. Conduct technical demonstrations that illustrate how specific products solve business hurdles to increase revenue and expand market share. Mentor extended sales teams to strengthen collective knowledge and guide structured educational initiatives across the organization.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 7+ years of related experience
  • Experience in technical sales or serving as a technical advisor for enterprise customers and partners
  • Proficiency in Cisco's technology portfolio and cross-architectural solution design.
  • Experience leading the technical sales process from opportunity identification through to closing deals
  • Background in competitive market analysis and displacement strategies within enterprise accounts.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of pre-sales experience
  • Ability to translate complex business needs into clear technical requirements for diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership skills to motivate and guide virtual support and extended sales teams.
  • Experience providing strategic feedback to Business Entities regarding market trends and customer needs.
  • Proven track record of influencing strategic priorities for C-suite and technical executives.
  • Adaptability to evolve strategies in response to shifting market conditions and competitive tactics.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

The starting salary range posted for this position is $202,400.00 to $257,900.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits.

Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.

U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

  • 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees

  • 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco

  • Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees

  • Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)

  • 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next

  • Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members

  • Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

  • .75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;

  • 1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%;

  • 1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and

  • Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

$202,400.00 - $296,900.00

raw.excerpt: Getlabs is the leading platform for at-home diagnostics.
raw.description:
Getlabs is the leading platform for at-home diagnostics.
Healthcare organizations use Getlabs to send mobile phlebotomists to patients’ homes and collect labs, vitals, and advanced diagnostics. By leveraging Getlabs, partners can improve patient adherence and close gaps in care with same-day, nationwide availability.
Our team has raised $50M from strategic investors including the two largest diagnostic laboratories in the United States, Labcorp and Quest. Getlabs’ mission is to save lives by expanding access to diagnostics for everyone.
The Phlebotomist Senior Team Lead oversees operational performance, quality compliance, and leadership development across a multi-market region. Building on the Team Lead foundation, this role leads, coaches, and holds accountable a group of phlebotomists and shift leads, serving as the escalation point above the Team Lead level, if supervisor is unavailable. Operating under Leader Standard Work (LSW), the Senior Team Lead maintains clinical competency with a reduced patient appointment load, shifting focus from daily execution to regional coverage strategy, performance trend analysis, process improvement, and partnership with Operations Management.

THIS IS A REMOTE POSITION!

This position is currently limited to candidates residing within a 20-30 mile radius of San Francisco, CA.

At Getlabs, you will:

    Team Lead Leadership & Development

  • Directly supervise, coach, and develop assigned teams; conduct weekly 1:1s and monthly performance check-ins.

  • Audit Team adherence to Leader Standard Work, the 20/24 Rule, and call-out procedures; provide feedback and corrective coaching as needed.

  • Train and certify new Team on LSW, routing, payroll/triplog audits, and quality assessment standards.

  • Identify high-potential phlebotomists and build a succession pipeline for future Team Lead roles.

    • Regional Operations & Escalation Management

  • Serve as the Tier 2 escalation point for operational, clinical, and patient issues that Team Leads cannot resolve within the 20/24 Rule.

  • Own weekly regional coverage planning, including PRN pool strategy, cross-market staffing, and capacity forecasting for upcoming demand.

  • Review Team route optimization and next-day coverage plans; intervene on high-risk markets to protect availability and reschedule targets.

  • Provide final review and sign-off on Team Payroll, Triplog, timecard, and expense submissions before payroll deadlines.

  • Oversee regional inventory and equipment budgets; analyze supply usage trends and approve purchase orders and new hire equipment requests.

    • Quality, Performance Analysis & Process Improvement

  • Analyze regional quality and performance data (redraws, critical errors, NPS, reschedules) to identify trends and root causes; build and track action plans with Team.

  • Calibrate venipuncture assessments and SOP audits across Team to ensure consistent quality standards across markets.

  • Lead formal corrective action and performance improvement plans in partnership with HR and Operations Management; review Team -issued corrective actions for consistency.

  • Identify process gaps and recommend SOP, training, and workflow improvements; pilot and roll out approved changes across the region.

  • Prepare and present regional performance reports to Operations Management on a weekly and monthly cadence.

    • Hiring, Onboarding & Training Strategy

  • Partner with Recruiting on regional hiring needs; conduct final-round interviews and make hiring recommendations.

  • Own the regional onboarding and training plan, ensuring Team Leads deliver consistent new hire onboarding, ride-alongs, and field training.

  • Develop and deliver advanced clinical and leadership training for Team Leads and senior phlebotomists.

    • Shared Supervisor Duties

  • Serve as acting supervisor during Operations Supervisor PTO, absences, and peak periods, with authority to make same-day staffing, scheduling, and escalation decisions.

  • Approve time-off requests, schedule changes, and overtime for phlebotomists within established guidelines.

  • Co-lead performance reviews for phlebotomists and Shift Leads, providing documented feedback and development goals.

  • Partner with the Supervisor and HR on documenting and delivering written warnings and final corrective actions, in line with company policy.

  • Address employee relations concerns at the first level and escalate to the Supervisor or HR when appropriate.

  • Ensure regional compliance with OSHA, HIPAA, and state phlebotomy regulations; lead incident reporting and follow-up for needlesticks, specimen loss, and patient complaints.

  • Represent the region in supervisor and leadership meetings, and cascade company updates and policy changes to Team.

  • Track regional labor costs, overtime, and mileage against budget targets and flag variances to the Supervisor.

    • Performance & Quality Targets

  • Redraw Rate: Maintain low redraw rates across all assigned markets/regions through clinical oversight and quality standards.

  • Critical Error Rate: Minimize critical errors and process deviations across all assigned markets/region.

  • Net Promoter Score (NPS): Drive strong regional patient satisfaction and high Net Promoter Scores.

  • Market Stability: Maintain high operational stability by managing reschedule rates and slot availability targets across the region.

  • Team Lead Effectiveness: Ensure assigned Team Leads maintain full adherence to Leader Standard Work and operational protocols.

  • Team Retention: Support regional phlebotomists and Team retention goals.

What we are looking for:

  • 2+ years of leadership experience (team lead, supervisor, or similar role) in phlebotomy, mobile health, clinical laboratory, or field-based healthcare operations
  • Experience leading other leads or managing teams across multiple sites or markets
  • 5 years of phlebotomy experience is required
  • Phlebotomy certification from an accredited agency is required: American Medical Technologists (AMT), American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP), or National Center for Competency Testing (NCCT)
  • Expert knowledge of phlebotomy techniques, specimen handling, and safety and compliance standards (OSHA, HIPAA)
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and hold leaders accountable
  • Strong analytical skills; comfortable using data and reports to drive decisions
  • Proven track record in providing exceptional customer service
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, including presenting to leadership
  • A disciplined, self-directed leader who can manage multiple markets and priorities
  • Comfortable with digital tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, and scheduling or routing software
  • Reliable transportation, clean driving record, and ability to pass a background check and drug screen
  • Ability to travel up to 40% for market visits, Team Lead development, onboarding, and field training

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Mobile phlebotomy experience
  • Experience with route planning, dispatch, or workforce scheduling for field-based teams
  • Experience approving timecards, payroll, or expenses and managing supply inventory
  • Familiarity with Lean practices or Leader Standard Work

We have great benefits to make your life easier so you can focus on what you're best at:

  • Competitive annual salary ranging $80,000-$95,000
  • Medical, dental and vision insurance options
  • Flexible vacation
  • A company with a huge vision, a dynamic work environment, and a team of talented, ambitious and fun to work-with colleagues!
The health and safety of our employees and their families is our top priority. Due to the ongoing nature of the COVID-19 pandemic we have decided to require vaccination as a condition of employment for any employee who is in contact with patients.
